--[[
	Part-Icles runtime. Call :Activate() once at start and :Deactivate() at teardown.

	Emit
	  :Emit(item, link?, emitCtx?)               one emit on item
	  :EmitAnimate(item, link?, emitCtx?)        one Animate cycle on item
	  :EnableEmit(item, link?, emitCtx?)         its EmitCount, EmitDelay and EmitDuration
	  :EnableEmitAt(item, origin, options?)      EnableEmit from origin -> (handle, duration?)
	  :AbsoluteEmit(item, _, emitCtx?)           item and every emitter under it -> duration?
	  :AbsoluteEmitAt(item, origin, options?)    AbsoluteEmit from origin -> (handle, duration?)
	    duration is nil for an endless play. origin: a CFrame, a Vector3 or an instance (followed
	    through EmitDelay); a container keeps its layout around it. options: Link, LinkMode,
	    EmitParent (this play only, unless Persist), Count, Delay, Duration, UseFullOrigin,
	    IgnoreLink, LinkOverride, OriginResolver, ChainCtx. The handle (:Disable, :SoftDisable,
	    :SetTimescale, :GetParticles, :IsAlive, :Wait) acts on that play only; a rejected call
	    warns and returns an inert handle.

	On and off
	  :Enable(item, link?, duration?, emitCtx?)  emits for duration (forever by default)
	  :Disable(item)                             stops and removes its particles now
	  :SoftDisable(item)                         stops; live particles finish their Lifetime
	  :AbsoluteEnable(item), :AbsoluteDisable(item)   the same over everything under item

	Timescale
	  :SetTimescale(item, scale, duration?, permanent?)   overrides the Timescale graph
	  :ClearTimescale(item)
	  :AbsoluteSetTimescale, :AbsoluteClearTimescale      over everything under item

	Other
	  :Transform(part), :TransformModel(model, typeDef)   makes an item a part-icle
	  :Preload(root, force?), :Deload(root, force?)       pins / releases textures
	  :SetLink(item, target, mode?), :SetEmitParent(item, parent)
	  :GetData(item), :GetFolder(), :GetPoolFolder(), :ReapplyLink(pData)
	  .await(n), .parseDuration(raw), .LinkService, .TransformCompleted, .Log

	emitCtx (optional): ChainCtx, EmitIndex, EmitCount, EventOriginCF, EventOriginResolver,
	UseFullOrigin, IgnoreLink, Overrides.
]]

local Log = require(script.Log)

local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local _RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Particles)

local Particle = {}
Particle.Beam = {}
-- Window focus, on clients; Deactivate releases these.
Particle._focused = true
Particle._unfocusedAt = 0
if _RunService:IsClient() then
	Particle._focusConn = UIS.WindowFocused:Connect(function() Particle._focused = true; Particle._unfocusedAt = 0 end)
	Particle._blurConn = UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() Particle._focused = false; Particle._unfocusedAt = os.clock() end)
end

-- Engine state.
Particle.ActiveEmits = {}    -- pData of every live copy; the engine step walks this
Particle.ActiveLoops = {}    -- item → Enable-loop task thread
Particle.ActiveAnimates = {} -- item → pData (max 1 cycle per source)
-- Loops started by event chains, apart so chains fired together do not cancel each other.
Particle.ActiveChainLoops = {}
-- EvenDistribution's counter per emitter (_EvenCycleId), shared by its copies.
Particle._evenCycleStore = {}
Particle.Connection = nil
Particle._engineGen = 0
-- Hard cap on concurrent particles; user Module code still runs at cap.
Particle.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES = 1000
Particle._capWarnLastAt = 0
-- Visuals lingering past their play (PartLife) count toward the cap.
Particle._lingerVisualCount = 0
-- RenderTemplates whose images are preloaded (ImageEmit).
Particle._preloadedAssets = require(script.InstanceMap).new()

-- Mixin pattern: sub-modules attach methods to Particle.
require(script.GetData)(Particle)
require(script.EmitOverrides)(Particle)
require(script.Transform)(Particle)
require(script.Update)(Particle)
require(script.UpdateAttachment)(Particle)
require(script.UpdateBeam)(Particle)
-- Before the Emit mixins, which call _seedTsOverride.
require(script.Timescale)(Particle)
require(script.Emit)(Particle)
require(script.EmitAttachment)(Particle)
require(script.EmitAnimate)(Particle)
require(script.EmitModel)(Particle)
require(script.UpdateModel)(Particle)
require(script.PointLight)(Particle)
require(script.Sound)(Particle)
require(script.Highlight)(Particle)
require(script.Lightning)(Particle)
require(script.CameraShake)(Particle)
require(script.Rocks)(Particle)
require(script.Rope)(Particle)
require(script.Distortion)(Particle)
require(script.Container)(Particle)
require(script.Force)(Particle)
require(script.Matte)(Particle)
require(script.Reactor)(Particle)
require(script.TrailEmitter)(Particle)
require(script.ScreenEmit)(Particle)
require(script.ImageEmit)(Particle)
require(script.LinkTrack)(Particle)
require(script.Orientation)(Particle)
require(script.ZOffset)(Particle)
require(script.Engine)(Particle)
require(script.EngineReplay)(Particle)
require(script.PreSimulate)(Particle)
require(script.RegisterEmit)(Particle)
-- Last: Lifecycle uses the mixins above.
require(script.Lifecycle)(Particle)
require(script.LifecycleRelease)(Particle)
require(script.EmitAt)(Particle)
require(script.Absolute)(Particle)

-- Warns once when an emit comes before :Activate(): its particles would never move.
function Particle:_warnIfNotActivated(methodName)
	if self.Connection then return end
	if self._notActivatedWarned then return end
	self._notActivatedWarned = true
	Log.warn(string.format(
		"[Part-Icles] :%s() called before :Activate()  -  particles will not update until the engine is activated. Call Particle:Activate() once at startup.",
		methodName
	))
end

-- Orientation and ZOffset on the emit frame, so the first frame does not snap.
function Particle:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local camPos = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
	-- Seed _postUpdateCF from spawn pose so frame-1 overlays don't compound on themselves.
	local hasO = pData.Orientation and pData.Orientation ~= "None"
	local hasZ = pData.ZOffset and pData.ZOffset ~= 0
	if hasO or hasZ then pData._postUpdateCF = (t == "Model") and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame end
	if hasO then self:ApplyOrientation(pData, 1/60, camPos) end
	if hasZ then self:ApplyZOffset(pData, camPos) end
end

-- One emit, dispatched by type. link: what the emit is tied to (Parts, Attachments, Models).
function Particle:Emit(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	self:_warnIfNotActivated("Emit")
	-- At the cap the visual is skipped (an event's Module still runs); one warning a second.
	local cap = self.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES or 1000
	if #self.ActiveEmits + (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) >= cap then
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (self._capWarnLastAt or 0) >= 1 then
			self._capWarnLastAt = now
			Log.warn(("[Part-Icles] active particle cap (%d) reached  -  new emits skipped (user Module code still runs)."):format(cap))
		end
		return
	end
	if item:IsA("Beam") and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") then
		self:EmitBeam(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Beam") or (item:IsA("Trail") and not item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties")) then
		-- BeamNative or a plain Trail: switched on for EmitDuration (the larger of a "min,max").
		local raw, d = item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"), 0
		if typeof(raw) == "number" then d = raw
		elseif raw ~= nil then local m1, m2 = tostring(raw):match("([%-%.%d]+)%s*,%s*([%-%.%d]+)")
			d = (m1 and m2) and math.max(tonumber(m1) or 0, tonumber(m2) or 0) or (tonumber(tostring(raw)) or 0)
		end
		if d > 0 then
			task.delay(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0, function()
				if not (item and item.Parent) then return end
				item.Enabled = true
				task.delay(d, function() if item and item.Parent then item.Enabled = false end end)
			end)
		end
	elseif item:IsA("Trail") then
		self:EmitTrail(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Light") then
		self:EmitPointLight(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Sound") then
		self:EmitSound(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Highlight") then
		self:EmitHighlight(item, link, emitCtx)
	-- A Container is an Attachment or a BasePart: before both of their branches.
	elseif Particle._isContainer(item) then
		self:EmitContainer(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isForce(item) then
		self:EmitForce(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isMatte(item) then
		self:EmitMatte(item, link, emitCtx)
	-- A Reactor is a Model or a BasePart: before both of their branches.
	elseif Particle._isReactor(item) then
		self:EmitReactor(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then
		self:EmitAttachment(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Model") then
		self:EmitModel(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("BlurEffect") then
		self:EmitBlur(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("BloomEffect") then
		self:EmitBloom(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		self:EmitColorCorrection(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Atmosphere") then
		self:EmitAtmosphere(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		self:EmitImageLabel(item, link, emitCtx)
	-- Lightning / CameraShake / Rocks / Rope before the BasePart fallback or they route to EmitPart.
	elseif Particle._isLightning(item) then
		self:EmitLightning(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isCameraShake(item) then
		self:EmitCameraShake(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isRocks(item) then
		self:EmitRocks(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isRope(item) then
		self:EmitRope(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif Particle._isDistortion(item) then
		self:EmitDistortion(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then
		self:EmitPart(item, link, emitCtx)
	end
end

-- Waits n seconds; nil or none returns at once, so Particle.await(Particle:AbsoluteEmit(item))
-- is safe for an endless play.
function Particle.await(n)
	if n == nil then return end
	if type(n) ~= "number" then return end
	if n <= 0 then return end
	task.wait(n)
end

-- Preload pins the textures under root so a first emit does not stall; Deload frees them. Only
-- items with PreloadTexture, or every one with force.
local _TexturePin = require(script.TexturePin)
local function _isPreloadable(i) return i:GetAttribute("Transformed") or i:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or i:IsA("Trail") end
local function _walk(root, force, action)
	if not root then return end
	local function visit(inst)
		if _isPreloadable(inst) and (force or inst:GetAttribute("PreloadTexture") == true) then action(inst) end
		for _, c in inst:GetChildren() do visit(c) end
	end
	visit(root)
end
function Particle:Preload(root, force) _walk(root, force, _TexturePin.pinSubtree) end
function Particle:Deload(root, force) _walk(root, force, _TexturePin.unpinSubtree) end

-- Link tracking for any BasePart, Model or Attachment, without emitting.
Particle.LinkService = require(script.LinkService)
-- Console gate: `Particle.Log.enabled = false` silences the runtime's prints / warns (plugin: Settings toggle).
Particle.Log = Log
Particle.parseDuration = ParticlesMod.parseDuration

-- Sets the item's own Link (EmitAt's options last one play). target: an instance, "camera" or
-- nil; mode: Follow, Pivot, Weld or WeldWithoutRotation.
function Particle:SetLink(item, target, mode)
	if not item or not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	if target == "camera" then
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "Camera") end)
	elseif target == nil then
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "None") end)
		local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
		if lk and lk:IsA("ObjectValue") then lk.Value = nil end
	elseif typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
		if not lk then
			lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
			lk.Name = "Link"
			lk.Parent = item
		end
		lk.Value = target
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "Object") end)
	end
	if mode then pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkMode", mode) end) end
end

-- Where the item's copies go; nil for the engine's folder.
function Particle:SetEmitParent(item, parent)
	if not item or not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	if parent == nil then
		local ep = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
		if ep then pcall(function() ep:Destroy() end) end
		return
	end
	if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then return end
	local ep = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
	if not ep then
		ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		ep.Name = "EmitParent"
		ep.Parent = item
	end
	ep.Value = parent
end

-- The public shape, for autocomplete: the mixins attach methods at run time.
export type ParticleAPI = {
	-- Lifecycle
	Activate: (self: ParticleAPI) -> (),
	Deactivate: (self: ParticleAPI) -> (),
	Enable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, duration: number?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	Disable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	SoftDisable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	AbsoluteEnable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	AbsoluteDisable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),

	-- Emit
	Emit: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	EmitAnimate: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	EnableEmit: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	EnableEmitAt: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, origin: CFrame | Vector3 | Instance, options: {[string]: any}?) -> (any, number?),
	AbsoluteEmit: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, _parentFiredPE: boolean?, emitCtx: any?) -> number?,
	AbsoluteEmitAt: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, origin: CFrame | Vector3 | Instance, options: {[string]: any}?) -> (any, number?),

	-- Timescale
	SetTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, scale: number, duration: number?, permanent: boolean?) -> (),
	ClearTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	AbsoluteSetTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, scale: number, duration: number?, permanent: boolean?) -> (),
	AbsoluteClearTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),

	-- Authoring + utilities
	Transform: (self: ParticleAPI, part: Instance) -> (),
	TransformModel: (self: ParticleAPI, model: Model, typeDef: any) -> (),
	Preload: (self: ParticleAPI, root: Instance, force: boolean?) -> (),
	Deload: (self: ParticleAPI, root: Instance, force: boolean?) -> (),
	SetLink: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, target: (Instance | string)?, mode: string?) -> (),
	SetEmitParent: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, parent: Instance?) -> (),
	GetData: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> any,
	GetFolder: (self: ParticleAPI) -> Folder,
	GetPoolFolder: (self: ParticleAPI) -> Folder,
	ReapplyLink: (self: ParticleAPI, pData: any) -> (),

	-- Statics
	await: (n: number?) -> (),
	parseDuration: (raw: any) -> number?,
	LinkService: typeof(require(script.LinkService)),
	TransformCompleted: BindableEvent,
	Beam: {[string]: any},
	MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES: number,
	ActiveEmits: {any},
	ActiveLoops: {[Instance]: thread},
	ActiveAnimates: {[Instance]: any},
}

return Particle :: ParticleAPI

--[[
	Absolute mixin: the recursive forms of Emit, Enable, Disable, SetTimescale and ClearTimescale;
	each acts on `item` and everything below it.
	  :AbsoluteEmit(item, _parentFiredPE?, emitCtx?) -> duration: number?
	  :AbsoluteEnable(item) / :AbsoluteDisable(item)
	  :AbsoluteSetTimescale(item, scale, duration?, permanent?) / :AbsoluteClearTimescale(item)
	One rule for all five: a transformed item is handed to its own method and ends the walk there;
	anything else is walked through at any depth. Emit, Enable and Disable reach the native emitters
	of a BasePart, Attachment or Model in one pass over its descendants and carry a flag down so none
	is reached twice.
	Consumers: EmitAt.luau calls :_absoluteEmitFire for raw Trail / Beam roots and its stripped clone;
	the plugin's Emit button and Emit Code tool call :AbsoluteEmit.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.EngineAttr)
local Duration = require(script.Parent.Duration)

-- True for a descendant under a transformed item below `root`: that item reaches it.
local function hasTransformedAncestor(descendant, root)
	local parent = descendant.Parent
	while parent and parent ~= root do
		if parent:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
		parent = parent.Parent
	end
	return false
end

-- True for holders whose native emitters one pass over their descendants reaches.
local function holdsNatives(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")
end

local function isNative(item)
	return item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Beam")
end

-- Sets Enabled on every native emitter under `holder` that no transformed item below it owns.
local function setNativesEnabled(holder, enabled)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(holder:GetDescendants()) do
		if isNative(descendant)
			and not descendant:GetAttribute("Transformed")
			and not hasTransformedAncestor(descendant, holder) then
			pcall(function() descendant.Enabled = enabled end)
		end
	end
end

return function(Particle)

	-- A transformed item runs EnableEmit (full emit timing); a raw ParticleEmitter / Trail / Beam is
	-- fired by its own attributes; anything else is walked. `_parentFiredPE` is set once an ancestor's
	-- pass has fired the native emitters below it.
	function Particle:_absoluteEmitFire(item, _parentFiredPE, emitCtx)
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			self:EnableEmit(item, nil, emitCtx)
			return
		end

		-- Engine-session predicate for the native helpers: a delayed :Emit / :Enable must not fire after Particle:Deactivate.
		local alive = self:_makeAliveCheck()

		-- Raw ParticleEmitter: fired by its own attributes, EmitMode included (Particles.fireEmitter).
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			if _parentFiredPE then return end
			ParticlesMod.fireEmitter(item, alive)
			return
		end

		-- Raw Trail: enabled for its EmitDuration (a "min,max" range is parsed there).
		if item:IsA("Trail") then
			if _parentFiredPE then return end
			ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(item, alive)
			return
		end

		-- Raw Beam: enabled for its EmitDuration; without one its Enabled is left alone.
		if item:IsA("Beam") then
			if _parentFiredPE then return end
			local emitDuration = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
			local emitDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
			if emitDuration > 0 then
				local scheduledGen = ParticlesMod.ReadNativeGen(item)
				local function doEmit()
					if not alive() or not ParticlesMod.IsNativeGenCurrent(item, scheduledGen) then return end
					ParticlesMod.SetEnabledForDuration(item, emitDuration)
				end
				if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
			end
			return
		end

		local firesNatives = holdsNatives(item) and not _parentFiredPE
		if firesNatives then ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(item, alive) end

		local covered = firesNatives or _parentFiredPE
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			self:_absoluteEmitFire(child, covered, emitCtx)
		end
	end

	-- Returns the real seconds until the last effect started is over (EmitDelay + EmitDuration +
	-- Timescale-distorted Lifetime + PartLife, nested included), or nil when a branch never ends
	-- (unbounded AnimateLoop, Timescale 0). Pair with .await(n). emitCtx: see init.luau's header.
	function Particle:AbsoluteEmit(item, _parentFiredPE, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("AbsoluteEmit")
		if not item then return 0 end
		self:_absoluteEmitFire(item, _parentFiredPE, emitCtx)
		return Duration.computeMaxDuration(item, 0)
	end

	-- A transformed item gets cfg.Enabled = true and :Enable(math.huge); raw PE / Trail / Beam get Enabled = true.
	function Particle:AbsoluteEnable(item, _parentCovered)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			-- _PartIclePlaying goes on before cfg.Enabled flips: the plugin's EnabledLoop listener bails on it,
			-- so the Enable below is the only loop started.
			EngineAttr.write(item, "_PartIclePlaying", true)
			local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
			if config then EngineAttr.write(config, "Enabled", true) end
			self:Enable(item, nil, math.huge)
			return
		end
		if isNative(item) then
			if _parentCovered then return end
			pcall(function() item.Enabled = true end)
			return
		end
		local covers = holdsNatives(item) and not _parentCovered
		if covers then setNativesEnabled(item, true) end
		local covered = covers or _parentCovered
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			self:AbsoluteEnable(child, covered)
		end
	end

	-- SOFT disable: a transformed item gets :SoftDisable (live particles finish their Lifetime); raw
	-- PE / Trail / Beam get Enabled = false. For an instant clear call :Disable per item.
	function Particle:AbsoluteDisable(item, _parentCovered)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			self:SoftDisable(item)
			return
		end
		if isNative(item) then
			if _parentCovered then return end
			pcall(function() item.Enabled = false end)
			return
		end
		local covers = holdsNatives(item) and not _parentCovered
		if covers then setNativesEnabled(item, false) end
		local covered = covers or _parentCovered
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			self:AbsoluteDisable(child, covered)
		end
	end

	-- Transformed items and raw ParticleEmitters both end the walk.
	function Particle:AbsoluteSetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			self:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
			return
		end
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			self:AbsoluteSetTimescale(child, scale, duration, permanent)
		end
	end

	-- The same walk.
	function Particle:AbsoluteClearTimescale(item)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			self:ClearTimescale(item)
			return
		end
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			self:AbsoluteClearTimescale(child)
		end
	end

end

--[[
	AtRest: the native Beams and Lights of a RenderTemplate are off while nothing plays.

	A Beam and a Light ignore the Transparency of the part they sit on, so left on in a hidden
	RenderTemplate they would draw and shine at the source. Transform, and the plugin's Fix for older
	items, turn each off and mark it with ATTRIBUTE; a copy of the RenderTemplate has the marked ones
	on again, and so has the RenderTemplate itself while an Animate play shows it.

	  silence(template)   Transform, Fix: the ones that are on and unmarked go off and are marked
	  silenceHeld(node)   the same for something about to be put into a RenderTemplate
	  needs(template)     true while one is on and unmarked (Migrate/Natives)
	  wakeCopy(copy)      one copied instance: on again when marked (Pool.copyBare)
	  wake(template)      an Animate play starts on the live RenderTemplate: the marked ones on
	  rest(template)      that play is over: the marked ones off

	A marked Beam or Light that is on is left alone by silence and needs (a play or its author turned it
	on). Without a mark a Beam or Light keeps its own Enabled in every copy. A nested transformed item's
	contents are never entered. Only a BasePart's or Attachment's RenderTemplate is silenced; a Model's
	shows its parts at rest, Beams and Lights included.
]]

local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.EngineAttr)

local AtRest = {}

AtRest.ATTRIBUTE = "_authoredEnabled"

local function isNative(instance)
	return instance:IsA("Beam") or instance:IsA("Light")
end

local function isMarked(instance)
	return instance:GetAttribute(AtRest.ATTRIBUTE) == true
end

-- Turns `node` off and marks it if it is a Beam or Light that is on and unmarked, then the same for
-- what it holds. Returns true when anything changed.
local function silenceTree(node)
	if node:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		return false
	end
	local changed = false
	if isNative(node) and node.Enabled and not isMarked(node) then
		node:SetAttribute(AtRest.ATTRIBUTE, true)
		node.Enabled = false
		changed = true
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
		if silenceTree(child) then
			changed = true
		end
	end
	return changed
end

-- True when a Beam or Light under `node` is on and unmarked.
local function treeNeeds(node)
	if node:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		return false
	end
	if isNative(node) and node.Enabled and not isMarked(node) then
		return true
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
		if treeNeeds(child) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Sets Enabled on every marked Beam and Light under `node` (writes the user's LIVE instance).
local function setMarked(node, enabled)
	for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			if isNative(child) and isMarked(child) and child.Enabled ~= enabled then
				EngineAttr.writeProp(child, "Enabled", enabled)
			end
			setMarked(child, enabled)
		end
	end
end

-- True for a RenderTemplate whose own look is hidden at rest.
function AtRest.applies(template)
	return template ~= nil and (template:IsA("BasePart") or template:IsA("Attachment"))
end

-- Mutates the item's LIVE RenderTemplate (Transform, Fix): every Beam and Light that is on goes off
-- and is marked. Returns true when any did.
function AtRest.silence(template)
	if not AtRest.applies(template) then
		return false
	end
	local changed = false
	for _, child in ipairs(template:GetChildren()) do
		if silenceTree(child) then
			changed = true
		end
	end
	return changed
end

-- The same for `node` and what it holds, before it goes into a hidden RenderTemplate (ForgeConverter/Helpers).
function AtRest.silenceHeld(node)
	return silenceTree(node)
end

function AtRest.needs(template)
	if not AtRest.applies(template) then
		return false
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(template:GetChildren()) do
		if treeNeeds(child) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- `copy` is one instance of a CLONE of a RenderTemplate, attributes copied with it.
function AtRest.wakeCopy(copy)
	if isNative(copy) and isMarked(copy) then
		copy.Enabled = true
	end
end

-- Mutates the LIVE RenderTemplate for an Animate play. Every end of such a play runs rest (Engine's
-- finishAnimate, Lifecycle's cancelAnimation), and each cycle wakes again.
function AtRest.wake(template)
	setMarked(template, true)
end

function AtRest.rest(template)
	setMarked(template, false)
end

return AtRest

--[[
	AxisLinks: graph-axis alias pass shared by EmitPart and the AnimateLoop refresh. When two axes are
	linked, the follower's graph and seed point at the primary's so they track tick-for-tick. `sanitize`
	is the chokepoint that filters cross-group, self, chain and cycle links.
]]

local AxisLinks = {}

local GRAPH_FOLLOWERS = {"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ","RotSpeedX","RotSpeedY","RotSpeedZ","PosOffsetX","PosOffsetY","PosOffsetZ"}

-- Same-group axis link metadata; cross-group links are rejected at sanitize.
local AXIS_GROUPS = {
	{"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"},
	{"RotSpeedX","RotSpeedY","RotSpeedZ"},
	{"PosOffsetX","PosOffsetY","PosOffsetZ"},
	{"RotX","RotY","RotZ"},
	{"PosX","PosY","PosZ"},
}
local AXIS_GROUP_OF = {}
for _, group in ipairs(AXIS_GROUPS) do
	local set = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(group) do set[a] = true end
	for _, a in ipairs(group) do AXIS_GROUP_OF[a] = set end
end

-- Resolves a follower's link target; nil for no link, self, cross-group, chain or cycle.
local function resolveAxisLink(raw, follower)
	local primary = raw and raw[follower] or nil
	if not primary or primary == "" or primary == follower then return nil end
	local group = AXIS_GROUP_OF[follower]
	if not group or not group[primary] then return nil end
	local primaryLink = raw[primary]
	if primaryLink and primaryLink ~= "" and primaryLink ~= primary and group[primaryLink] then return nil end
	return primary
end

-- Sanitizes raw {axisKey -> rawAttrString} into resolved {follower -> primary or nil}.
function AxisLinks.sanitize(raw)
	local resolved = {}
	for _, group in ipairs(AXIS_GROUPS) do
		for _, a in ipairs(group) do resolved[a] = resolveAxisLink(raw, a) end
	end
	return resolved
end

function AxisLinks.applyGraphAxisAliases(graphs, seeds, axisLinks)
	if not axisLinks or not graphs or not seeds then return end
	for _, follower in ipairs(GRAPH_FOLLOWERS) do
		local primary = axisLinks[follower]
		if primary and primary ~= follower and graphs[primary] and seeds[primary] then
			graphs[follower] = graphs[primary]
			seeds[follower] = seeds[primary]
		end
	end
end

-- Range-axis sampler: primary axes are sampled once, linked followers reuse the primary's scalar.
-- EvenDistribution: `{axis}Even` + emitCtx gives a base spread t = i/count (skipping Min so circular
-- ranges do not collide at 0/360); count==1 with no active cycle is the midpoint. A rolling-cycle
-- offset (EvenOffsetIdx/N_Pos or _Rot) shifts the spread by (offIdx-1)/(N*count) each emission,
-- wrapping mod 1. With a cycle active, idx 1 must not take the midpoint shortcut: it goes through
-- the formula to t=1 so the rolling sweep stays continuous.
function AxisLinks.sampleRangeAxes(data, axisLinks, axes, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local emitIndex = emitCtx and emitCtx.EmitIndex
	local emitCount = emitCtx and emitCtx.EmitCount
	local first = axes[1] or ""
	local prefix = first:sub(1, 3)
	local offIdx, offN
	if prefix == "Pos" then
		offIdx = emitCtx and emitCtx.EvenOffsetIdx_Pos
		offN = emitCtx and emitCtx.EvenOffsetN_Pos
	elseif prefix == "Rot" then
		offIdx = emitCtx and emitCtx.EvenOffsetIdx_Rot
		offN = emitCtx and emitCtx.EvenOffsetN_Rot
	end
	local hasEvenCtx = emitIndex and emitCount and emitCount > 0
	local sampled = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(axes) do
		local primary = axisLinks and axisLinks[k]
		if not primary then
			local even = data[k .. "Even"] == true
			if even and hasEvenCtx then
				local r = data[k]
				local t
				local off = (offN and offN > 0) and ((offIdx - 1) / (offN * emitCount)) or 0
				local cycleActive = offN ~= nil and offN > 0
				if emitCount == 1 and off == 0 and not cycleActive then
					t = 0.5
				else
					t = emitIndex / emitCount + off
					if t > 1 then t = t - 1 end -- t < 2 guaranteed; single wrap to [0,1)
				end
				sampled[k] = r.Min + (r.Max - r.Min) * t
			else
				sampled[k] = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data[k])
			end
		end
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(axes) do
		if sampled[k] == nil then
			local primary = axisLinks and axisLinks[k]
			sampled[k] = (primary and sampled[primary]) or RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data[k])
		end
	end
	return sampled
end

-- AnimateLoop refresh: rebuilds Graphs from freshData, re-rolls seeds, re-applies axis aliases.
function AxisLinks.refreshLoopGraphsAndSeeds(pData, freshData, GraphMod)
	if not pData.Graphs then return end
	for k, _ in pairs(pData.Graphs) do
		if freshData[k] ~= nil then pData.Graphs[k] = freshData[k] end
	end
	if pData.Seeds then for k, _ in pairs(pData.Seeds) do
		if pData.Graphs[k] then pData.Seeds[k] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(pData.Graphs[k]) end
	end end
	AxisLinks.applyGraphAxisAliases(pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds, freshData.AxisLinks)
end

return AxisLinks

--[[
	CameraShake mixin: Emit + Animate + Update for positional camera-shake emitters.

	No visual clone: pData.VisualPart is nil (every engine teardown path guards it). Each live shake
	samples six decorrelated Perlin channels per frame, attenuates by camera distance to the emitter
	(ShakeFalloff, 0 = global), and adds the result to CameraShake/Apply's accumulator; Engine applies
	the summed offset to workspace.CurrentCamera once per step. Shakes sum linearly (small-angle Euler
	addition on the rotational channels).

	Nested emitters under a shake's RenderTemplate never fire (no clone to link); a shake as a nested
	child of Part/Model/Lightning works and its falloff origin rides the parent clone.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Apply = require(script.Apply)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

-- Non-integer channel offsets (math.noise returns 0 on the integer lattice).
local KX, KY, KZ = 0.17, 137.7, 291.3
local KRX, KRY, KRZ = 431.1, 557.5, 683.9

local warnedServer = false

return function(Particle)

-- Shared by the Emit dispatch in init.luau and the EmitAnimate dispatch in Lifecycle.
function Particle._isCameraShake(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") == true
end

local function buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	local seeds = {
		ShakeAmplitude = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ShakeAmplitude),
		ShakeRotAmplitude = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ShakeRotAmplitude),
		ShakeFrequency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ShakeFrequency),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	local pData = {
		Type = "CameraShake",
		VisualPart = nil,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = -1,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = 0,
		_sourceItem = item,
		Graphs = {
			ShakeAmplitude = data.ShakeAmplitude,
			ShakeRotAmplitude = data.ShakeRotAmplitude,
			ShakeFrequency = data.ShakeFrequency,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime),
		-- Noise phase = integral of ShakeFrequency over effective time (reverse timescale rewinds it).
		_shakePhase = 0,
		_falloff = data.ShakeFalloff or 0,
		_shakeSeed = math.random() * 997 + 0.5,
		_lastOriginPos = item.Position,
	}
	-- Event origin override (EnableEmitAt, Events AtPosition): falloff measures from it for the shake's life.
	if emitCtx then
		local originCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		originCF = originCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if originCF then pData._originOverride = originCF.Position end
		-- Carried by a Container or a Matte: its place on the parent clone (NestedEmit.keepPlace).
		if emitCtx._rigPlace then pData._parentPlace = emitCtx._rigPlace.Position end
	end
	return pData
end

function Particle:EmitCameraShake(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	-- The server has no camera; Heartbeat-driven server engines skip shakes.
	if not RunService:IsClient() then
		if not warnedServer then
			warnedServer = true
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] CameraShake ignored on the server (no camera).")
		end
		return
	end
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	if not data then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local pData = buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	-- Nested emit: the falloff origin rides the emitted parent clone.
	pData._parentLink = link
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Animate mode: one looping shake per source, no clone.
function Particle:EmitCameraShakeAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	if not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	if not data then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local pData = buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	pData._parentLink = link
	pData.IsAnimate = true
	pData.AnimateItem = item

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Per frame: envelopes (step-gated), noise channels (every frame, for smoothness), distance
-- attenuation, accumulate. Allocates nothing.
function Particle:UpdateCameraShake(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale header: see Lightning/init.luau UpdateLightning.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local newEff = (pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)
	if isDying then return true end

	-- Falloff origin: live parent clone, live source, then frozen last known.
	local origin = pData._originOverride
	if not origin then
		local link = pData._parentLink
		if link and link.Parent then
			origin = Constants.placeOnLink(link, pData._parentPlace)
		else
			local src = pData._sourceItem
			origin = (src and src.Parent) and src.Position or pData._lastOriginPos
		end
	end
	pData._lastOriginPos = origin

	local li = newEff / lifeTime
	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(li, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local si = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		pData._curAmp = pData.Graphs.ShakeAmplitude and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.ShakeAmplitude, pData.Seeds.ShakeAmplitude) or 0
		pData._curRotAmp = pData.Graphs.ShakeRotAmplitude and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.ShakeRotAmplitude, pData.Seeds.ShakeRotAmplitude) or 0
		pData._curFreq = pData.Graphs.ShakeFrequency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.ShakeFrequency, pData.Seeds.ShakeFrequency) or 10
	end
	if not pData._timeFrozen then
		pData._shakePhase = (pData._shakePhase or 0) + dtTs * (pData._curFreq or 10)
	end

	local atten = 1
	local falloff = pData._falloff
	if falloff > 0 then
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			atten = math.clamp(1 - (cam.CFrame.Position - origin).Magnitude / falloff, 0, 1)
		else
			atten = 0
		end
	end

	local amp = (pData._curAmp or 0) * atten
	local rotAmp = math.rad(pData._curRotAmp or 0) * atten
	if amp ~= 0 or rotAmp ~= 0 then
		local t = pData._shakePhase
		local s = pData._shakeSeed
		Apply.accumulate(
			amp * math.noise(t, s, KX), amp * math.noise(t, s, KY), amp * math.noise(t, s, KZ),
			rotAmp * math.noise(t, s, KRX), rotAmp * math.noise(t, s, KRY), rotAmp * math.noise(t, s, KRZ))
	end

	return false
end

-- AnimateLoop per-cycle refresh (EngineReplay dispatch): the generic replay refreshes Graphs, seeds
-- and LifeTime; only scalar shake fields are re-read. Noise seed and phase persist, so the loop is one rumble.
function Particle:_refreshCameraShakeAnimate(pData, freshData)
	pData.Link = nil
	pData._falloff = freshData.ShakeFalloff or 0
	pData._curAmp = nil
	pData._curRotAmp = nil
	pData._curFreq = nil
	pData.CurrentStep = -1
end

end

--[[
	CameraShake/Apply  -  module-level camera-offset accumulator.
	Every live CameraShake pData adds its frame contribution via accumulate(); Engine calls
	applyFrame() ONCE per step after the update loop, composing
	cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * prevApplied:Inverse() * newOffset.

	Removal ALWAYS composes, even when something else moved the camera since our last write: Studio's
	edit-mode camera controller builds each new pose on the current CFrame (our offset baked in), so
	unconditional removal keeps the camera level after the shake. Never compare CFrames for equality
	here: the engine orthonormalizes on write, so read-back is not bit-identical and an equality
	guard would skip removal every frame (offsets then random-walk into a permanent tilt). Play-mode
	camera scripts rewrite the camera wholesale each frame BEFORE this (priority 200 vs Last+1), so
	the stale removal there is a bounded one-frame error.
]]

local Apply = {}

local sumX, sumY, sumZ = 0, 0, 0
local rotX, rotY, rotZ = 0, 0, 0
local prevApplied = CFrame.identity
local hasApplied = false
local appliedCam = nil

-- Translation in studs (camera-local), rotation in radians.
function Apply.accumulate(dx, dy, dz, rx, ry, rz)
	sumX += dx; sumY += dy; sumZ += dz
	rotX += rx; rotY += ry; rotZ += rz
end

local function clearState()
	sumX, sumY, sumZ, rotX, rotY, rotZ = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	prevApplied = CFrame.identity
	hasApplied = false
	appliedCam = nil
end

function Apply.applyFrame()
	local active = sumX ~= 0 or sumY ~= 0 or sumZ ~= 0 or rotX ~= 0 or rotY ~= 0 or rotZ ~= 0
	if not hasApplied and not active then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		clearState()
		return
	end
	-- Camera swapped since our last write: the offset lives on the OLD camera. Remove it there; never
	-- compose the stale inverse on the new one.
	if appliedCam and appliedCam ~= cam then
		if hasApplied and appliedCam.Parent then
			pcall(function() appliedCam.CFrame = appliedCam.CFrame * prevApplied:Inverse() end)
		end
		prevApplied = CFrame.identity
		hasApplied = false
	end
	local newOffset = CFrame.new(sumX, sumY, sumZ) * CFrame.fromOrientation(rotX, rotY, rotZ)
	cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * prevApplied:Inverse() * newOffset
	prevApplied = newOffset
	hasApplied = active
	appliedCam = cam
	sumX, sumY, sumZ, rotX, rotY, rotZ = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
end

-- Synchronous restore + full clear. Engine Deactivate calls this; after it the
-- accumulator is cold and applyFrame's idle early-out costs a few compares.
function Apply.reset()
	if hasApplied and appliedCam and appliedCam.Parent then
		pcall(function() appliedCam.CFrame = appliedCam.CFrame * prevApplied:Inverse() end)
	end
	clearState()
end

return Apply

--[[
	Container Mixin  -  Emit + Update for Containers: a transformed Part or Attachment that draws
	nothing itself and drives the ParticleEmitters, Beams and Trails it holds.

	Each emit copies the RenderTemplate, fires every emitter the copy holds, at any depth (each
	with its own EmitCount / EmitDelay / EmitDuration) and, for the length of the play, writes their
	Rate, Size, TimeScale, Brightness, SpreadAngle, LightInfluence and LightEmission from the
	Container's graphs, and their Color from its colour by its Color Mode (Container/Drive,
	Container/Colors), at the position its Mode gives each emitter (Container/Clock). Only the
	COPY is written, so two plays never share a timeline. A graph's random envelope is rolled once
	per play and shared by every emitter.
	An Attachment copy rides a carrier that mirrors the source's part; a Part copy is moved to
	its source every frame. The parts under the copy's root are kept where the RenderTemplate
	has them from its own root (a part's CFrame does not move the parts under it).
	The copy is destroyed on release (no pool kind).
	Emit only: Lifecycle's Animate dispatch sends a Container here, because Animate plays the
	real RenderTemplate.
	Transformed items inside the RenderTemplate are carried: fired from the source (NestedEmit)
	with the copy as their link, each where it stands in the RenderTemplate. Each gets a record
	of what the Container asks of its particles (Drive.collectCarried), handed down as
	emitCtx._containerDrive. The native emitters, Beams and Trails inside a carried item's
	emitted copy are adopted (Particle:_adoptIntoContainer, called by those emits before they
	fire the copy) and driven like the Container's own. A transformed Beam or Trail reads its
	record in its own update (Container/Lines).
	Transparency (Container/Fade) reaches everything that draws: the copy's emitters, lines,
	plain parts, decals, Highlights and lights (Drive.collectSurfaces, taken only when the play
	fades), what a carried item's copy holds (Drive.adopt), and each carried part-icle through
	its record. A Container carried by another folds the outer one's fade into its own
	(pData._outer), all the way down.
	Pending emits stop when the copy is released, so the play is kept at least as long as they need.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local Clock = require(script.Clock)
local Colors = require(script.Colors)
local Drive = require(script.Drive)

-- A play whose clock is held still (timescale 0) is dropped after this long in real time.
local STALLED_PLAY_SECONDS = 180

return function(Particle)

-- Whether an item is a Container; Emit and Lifecycle's Animate dispatch use it.
function Particle._isContainer(item)
	return (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment")) and item:GetAttribute("IsContainer") == true
end

local function basePartAncestor(instance)
	local parent = instance.Parent
	while parent do
		if parent:IsA("BasePart") then
			return parent
		end
		parent = parent.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

-- Parents the copy and returns the carrier it rides, if any. An Attachment copy needs a part
-- above it: Emit Into, the parent play's copy, a carrier mirroring the source's part, or the
-- world carrier (VisualHost.worldCarrier).
local function hostAttachment(particle, item, copy, data, link, emitCtx)
	local worldCFrame = Constants.playOrigin(item.WorldCFrame, emitCtx)
	local parent = data.EmitParent or NestedEmit.resolveCloneParent(item, link, emitCtx)
	local carrier = nil
	if not parent then
		local anchor = basePartAncestor(item)
		if anchor then
			carrier = VisualHost.acquireCarrier(anchor)
			parent = carrier
		else
			parent = VisualHost.worldCarrier()
		end
	end
	local parentCFrame = CFrame.new()
	if parent:IsA("BasePart") then
		parentCFrame = parent.CFrame
	end
	copy.CFrame = parentCFrame:ToObjectSpace(worldCFrame)
	copy.Parent = parent
	return carrier
end

-- Parents a Part copy at the play's start frame. Returns true when it must follow its source.
local function hostPart(particle, item, copy, data, link, emitCtx)
	local worldCFrame, tiedToSource = Constants.playOrigin(item.CFrame, emitCtx)
	copy.CFrame = worldCFrame
	copy.Parent = data.EmitParent or NestedEmit.resolveCloneParent(item, link, emitCtx) or particle:GetFolder()
	return tiedToSource
end

-- The parts under the copy's root, each with its place from that root. Reads the RenderTemplate; the parts listed are the CLONE's.
local function layoutOf(copy, template)
	local map = Pool.cloneMapOf(copy)
	if not map then
		return nil
	end
	local rootFrame = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(template)
	local layout = nil
	for source, clone in pairs(map) do
		if clone ~= copy and clone:IsA("BasePart") then
			layout = layout or {}
			table.insert(layout, { part = clone, offset = rootFrame:ToObjectSpace(source.CFrame) })
		end
	end
	return layout
end

-- Sets the copy's own parts by where its root stands now. Writes only when the root has moved.
local function placeLayout(pData)
	local layout = pData._layout
	if not layout then
		return
	end
	local rootFrame = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(pData.VisualPart)
	if rootFrame == pData._layoutFrame then
		return
	end
	pData._layoutFrame = rootFrame
	for _, entry in ipairs(layout) do
		entry.part.CFrame = rootFrame * entry.offset
	end
end

function Particle:UpdateContainer(pData, dt, currentTime)
	local copy = pData.VisualPart
	if not copy or not copy.Parent then return true end
	if currentTime - pData.StartTime > STALLED_PLAY_SECONDS then return true end

	local timescale = 1
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		timescale = pData._tsOverride
	end
	local elapsed = pData._effectiveElapsed
	if not pData._timeFrozen then
		elapsed = math.clamp(elapsed + dt * timescale, 0, pData.LifeTime)
		pData._effectiveElapsed = elapsed
	end

	local followed = pData._followItem
	if followed and followed.Parent then
		copy.CFrame = followed.CFrame
	end
	placeLayout(pData)

	if pData._drives then
		Drive.step(pData, elapsed)
	end
	return elapsed >= pData.LifeTime
end

-- Called by EmitPart, EmitAttachment and EmitModel with their new play, before they fire the
-- native emitters of its copy (a CLONE): carried by a Container, those emitters are its to drive.
function Particle:_adoptIntoContainer(pData, emitCtx)
	local record = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive
	if record then
		Drive.adopt(record, pData)
	end
end

function Particle:EmitContainer(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local copy = Pool.acquireOrCopyBare(data.RenderTemplate, "Container", false)
	copy.Archivable = false
	-- Silent until fired below: an emitter left Enabled would start on its own once parented.
	for _, descendant in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			descendant.Enabled = false
		end
	end

	local driven = Drive.collect(copy)
	local lines = Drive.collectLines(copy)
	local activeGraphs = Drive.activeGraphs(data.DriveGraphs)
	local colorGraph = Drive.colorGraph(data.DriveColor, data.ColorMode)
	local colorReference = nil
	if colorGraph then
		colorReference = Colors.referenceHue(colorGraph)
	end
	local seeds = {}
	for key, graph in pairs(activeGraphs) do
		seeds[key] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(graph)
	end
	local timings = {}
	for index, record in ipairs(driven) do
		timings[index] = record.timing
	end
	local containerLife = math.max(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime), 0.001)
	-- A driven TimeScale stretches the native emitters' particles; carried items run on their own time.
	local carried, carriedByItem = Drive.collectCarried(data.RenderTemplate, function(carriedItem)
		return TypeRegistry.read(carriedItem, "Lifetime")
	end, TypeRegistry.getTypeName)
	-- Carried by another Container: its fade comes down on top of this one's.
	local outer = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive
	local fades = activeGraphs.DriveTransparency ~= nil or outer ~= nil
	local surfaces = {}
	if fades then
		surfaces = Drive.collectSurfaces(copy, nil)
	end
	local carriedTimings = {}
	for index, record in ipairs(carried) do
		carriedTimings[index] = record.timing
	end
	local lineTimings = {}
	for index, record in ipairs(lines) do
		lineTimings[index] = record.timing
	end
	local playLength = math.max(
		Clock.playLength(containerLife, timings, Drive.slowestTimescale(driven, activeGraphs)),
		Clock.playLength(containerLife, lineTimings, Drive.lowestTimescale(activeGraphs)),
		Clock.playLength(containerLife, carriedTimings, 1)
	)

	local carrier = nil
	local followItem = nil
	if copy:IsA("Attachment") then
		carrier = hostAttachment(self, item, copy, data, link, emitCtx)
	elseif hostPart(self, item, copy, data, link, emitCtx) then
		followItem = item
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "Container",
		VisualPart = copy,
		_carrier = carrier,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = 1,
		CurrentStep = -1,
		-- How long the copy is kept: the Container's own length, or longer while a last particle can still be in the air.
		LifeTime = playLength,
		PartLife = 0,
		Graphs = {},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = 0,

		-- From here to _sampledPosition: the play as Drive.step reads it.
		Mode = data.Mode,
		ContainerLife = containerLife,
		Driven = driven,
		Lines = lines,
		Carried = carried,
		Surfaces = surfaces,
		SurfaceTiming = { delay = 0, duration = 0, life = containerLife },
		ActiveGraphs = activeGraphs,
		ColorGraph = colorGraph,
		ColorMode = data.ColorMode,
		ColorReference = colorReference,
		Skips = data.DriveSkips,
		_outer = outer,
		_fades = fades,
		_drives = (next(activeGraphs) ~= nil or colorGraph ~= nil or outer ~= nil) and (#driven > 0 or #lines > 0 or #carried > 0 or #surfaces > 0),
		_values = {},
		_color = nil,
		_sampledPosition = nil,
		_followItem = followItem,
		_layout = layoutOf(copy, data.RenderTemplate),
		_layoutFrame = nil,
	}
	pData._sourceItem = item
	-- Before anything fires: an emitter on a plain part emits from where that part stands.
	placeLayout(pData)
	for _, record in ipairs(carried) do
		record.play = pData
	end
	pData._onReclaim = function()
		pData._released = true
	end
	-- Riding an emitted parent copy: die with it (Engine.step).
	pData._parentAlive = NestedEmit.parentAliveFor(data, emitCtx)
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)

	-- Rate and SpreadAngle only shape particles spawned after they are written.
	if pData._drives then
		Drive.step(pData, 0)
	end

	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- Everything Drive.collect took is fired (the copy holds nothing transformed, Pool.copyBare).
	local alive = self:_makeAliveCheck()
	for _, descendant in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(descendant, alive)
	end

	-- Nested Part-Icles: fired from the source RenderTemplate with the copy as their link.
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, copy, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx, nil, function(carriedItem, carriedCtx)
		carriedCtx._containerDrive = carriedByItem[carriedItem]
		NestedEmit.keepPlace(carriedItem, carriedCtx, data.RenderTemplate)
	end)
end

end

--[[
	Container/Clock  -  where on its graphs a Container holds one driven emitter, and how long a
	play lasts. Plain numbers only.
	  Clock.position(mode, elapsed, containerLife, timing) -> 0..1
	      elapsed        seconds since the play started
	      containerLife  the Container's Lifetime for this play
	      timing         { delay, duration, life }: the emitter's EmitDelay, its EmitDuration
	                     (0 for a burst) and its Lifetime.Max
	  Clock.playLength(containerLife, timings, slowestTimescale) -> seconds
	      until the Container's Lifetime is over and every emitter's last particle can have died
	  Clock.maxDuration(raw) -> seconds   an EmitDuration attribute: a number or a "min,max" text
	Modes are the strings of TypeDataContainer.MODES:
	  Absolute           one clock for every emitter: elapsed / containerLife
	  Relative           each emitter starts after its own delay, containerLife long
	  Relative Lifetime  starts after its delay, its own life long
	  Relative Span      starts after its delay, its duration + life long
	Before its start an emitter sits at 0; after its end it holds 1.
]]

local Clock = {}

-- A driven TimeScale under this counts as this when the play's length is worked out.
local SLOWEST_COUNTED_TIMESCALE = 0.1
-- No play is kept longer than this, whatever its emitters ask for.
local MAX_PLAY_SECONDS = 120

function Clock.position(mode, elapsed, containerLife, timing)
	local start = 0
	local length = containerLife
	if mode == "Relative" then
		start = timing.delay
	elseif mode == "Relative Lifetime" then
		start = timing.delay
		length = timing.life
	elseif mode == "Relative Span" then
		start = timing.delay
		length = timing.duration + timing.life
	end
	if elapsed <= start then
		return 0
	end
	if length <= 0 then
		return 1
	end
	return math.min((elapsed - start) / length, 1)
end

function Clock.playLength(containerLife, timings, slowestTimescale)
	local timescale = math.max(slowestTimescale or 1, SLOWEST_COUNTED_TIMESCALE)
	local length = containerLife
	for _, timing in ipairs(timings) do
		local lastParticleGone = timing.delay + timing.duration + timing.life / timescale
		if lastParticleGone > length then
			length = lastParticleGone
		end
	end
	return math.min(length, MAX_PLAY_SECONDS)
end

function Clock.maxDuration(raw)
	if type(raw) == "number" then
		return math.max(raw, 0)
	end
	if type(raw) ~= "string" then
		return 0
	end
	local longest = 0
	for text in string.gmatch(raw, "[^,]+") do
		local seconds = tonumber((string.gsub(text, "%s", "")))
		if seconds and seconds > longest then
			longest = seconds
		end
	end
	return longest
end

return Clock

--[[
	Container/Colors  -  what a Container's colour does to an emitter's own Color, by Color Mode.
	  Colors.MODES                          { "Recolor", "Colorize", "Shift", "Tint" }, as the panel lists them
	  Colors.isNeutral(sequence, mode)      true when that sequence changes nothing in that mode
	  Colors.referenceHue(sequence)         Shift's "as it is now": the first keypoint's hue, or
	                                        nil when that keypoint is white or grey
	  Colors.apply(base, driven, mode, referenceHue) -> ColorSequence
	      base: the emitter's own Color; driven: the Container's colour at this moment (Color3)
	  Colors.sequence(base, look) -> ColorSequence   every keypoint through a prepared look
	  Colors.prepare(look, driven, mode, referenceHue) -> look
	      works out once what a driven colour means in a mode, into a table the caller keeps
	  Colors.one(color, look) -> Color3        one colour through a prepared look
	  Colors.driven(cache, color, drive) -> Color3
	      for the mesh code: one colour through a carried record's look (Container/Drive). The
	      answer is kept on `cache` (a particle, a decal layer) and reused while neither the
	      colour nor the record's colour has changed.
	Modes, each acting on every keypoint of the emitter's Color:
	  Recolor  takes the driven colour's hue and keeps its own saturation and value; the driven
	           colour's saturation is the strength (white leaves the hue alone).
	  Shift    every hue turns by the angle between the sequence's first colour and the driven
	           colour, scaled by the driven saturation, so differently coloured emitters stay different.
	  Colorize as Recolor, and a white or grey keypoint is coloured too (driven hue and saturation,
	           its own value).
	  Tint     the keypoint is multiplied by the driven colour, channel by channel.
	A white or grey keypoint has no hue: Recolor and Shift leave it; Colorize and Tint colour it.
	White is neutral in all four. Hue arithmetic is in turns (0..1), the shorter way round.
]]

local Colors = {}

Colors.MODES = { "Recolor", "Colorize", "Shift", "Tint" }

-- Below this saturation a colour counts as white or grey: its hue means nothing.
local NO_HUE = 0.01
local NEARLY_ONE = 0.999

-- The signed turn from one hue to another, the shorter way round: -0.5 .. 0.5.
local function turnBetween(fromHue, toHue)
	return (toHue - fromHue + 0.5) % 1 - 0.5
end

function Colors.referenceHue(sequence)
	local hue, saturation = sequence.Keypoints[1].Value:ToHSV()
	if saturation < NO_HUE then
		return nil
	end
	return hue
end

function Colors.isNeutral(sequence, mode)
	local reference = Colors.referenceHue(sequence)
	for _, keypoint in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints) do
		local color = keypoint.Value
		if mode == "Tint" then
			if color.R < NEARLY_ONE or color.G < NEARLY_ONE or color.B < NEARLY_ONE then
				return false
			end
		else
			local hue, saturation = color:ToHSV()
			if saturation >= NO_HUE then
				if mode ~= "Shift" then
					return false
				end
				if reference and math.abs(turnBetween(reference, hue)) * saturation > 1 / 720 then
					return false
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function turned(color, turn)
	local hue, saturation, value = color:ToHSV()
	if saturation < NO_HUE then
		return color
	end
	return Color3.fromHSV((hue + turn) % 1, saturation, value)
end

local function recolored(color, drivenHue, strength)
	local hue, saturation, value = color:ToHSV()
	if saturation < NO_HUE then
		return color
	end
	return Color3.fromHSV((hue + turnBetween(hue, drivenHue) * strength) % 1, saturation, value)
end

function Colors.prepare(look, driven, mode, referenceHue)
	local hue, saturation = driven:ToHSV()
	look.mode = mode
	look.red = driven.R
	look.green = driven.G
	look.blue = driven.B
	look.hue = hue
	look.strength = saturation
	look.shift = 0
	if mode == "Shift" and referenceHue and saturation >= NO_HUE then
		look.shift = turnBetween(referenceHue, hue) * saturation
	end
	return look
end

function Colors.one(color, look)
	if look.mode == "Tint" then
		return Color3.new(color.R * look.red, color.G * look.green, color.B * look.blue)
	end
	if look.mode == "Shift" then
		if look.shift == 0 then
			return color
		end
		return turned(color, look.shift)
	end
	if look.strength < NO_HUE then
		return color
	end
	if look.mode == "Colorize" then
		local _, saturation, value = color:ToHSV()
		if saturation < NO_HUE then
			return Color3.fromHSV(look.hue, look.strength, value)
		end
	end
	return recolored(color, look.hue, look.strength)
end

function Colors.sequence(base, look)
	local keypoints = {}
	for index, keypoint in ipairs(base.Keypoints) do
		keypoints[index] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(keypoint.Time, Colors.one(keypoint.Value, look))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(keypoints)
end

function Colors.apply(base, driven, mode, referenceHue)
	return Colors.sequence(base, Colors.prepare({}, driven, mode, referenceHue))
end

function Colors.driven(cache, color, drive)
	if cache._lookStamp == drive.colorStamp and cache._lookFrom == color then
		return cache._lookColor
	end
	local result = Colors.one(color, drive.look)
	cache._lookStamp = drive.colorStamp
	cache._lookFrom = color
	cache._lookColor = result
	return result
end

return Colors

--[[
	Container/Drive  -  the driven ParticleEmitters, Beams and Trails of ONE emitted copy of a
	Container's RenderTemplate: what each started with, and what the Container's graphs write.
	Writes the COPY only; the RenderTemplate is never written.
	  Drive.collect(copy) -> { { emitter, timing = { delay, duration, life }, base } }
	  Drive.collectLines(copy) -> line records { line, kind = "Beam" | "Trail", timing, base, state }
	  Drive.collectSurfaces(root, leaveOut) -> plain parts, decals, lights and highlights to fade
	  Drive.collectCarried(renderTemplate, readLifetime, typeOf) -> records, byItem
	      One record per outermost transformed item carried, read (never written) by its own code
	      through pData._drive / emitCtx._containerDrive: kind ("Mesh", "Beam", "Trail", "Reactor"),
	      rate, scale, timescale, brightness (multipliers), spreadX, spreadY, lightInfluence,
	      lightEmission (added), look and colorStamp, transparency, fadeByKind and fadeStamp (a
	      carried Container's), play, emitters, lines.
	  Drive.stream(record, rate, dt) -> rate, streamDt   a carried item's Enable loop under the graphs
	  Drive.adopt(record, carriedPlay) -> count   a carried play's native emitters join this play;
	      the play is marked _noPool, as its copy now holds written values
	  Drive.activeGraphs(graphs), Drive.slowestTimescale(records, graphs), Drive.lowestTimescale(graphs)
	  Drive.colorGraph(sequence, mode), Drive.apply(record, values, play), Drive.fadeFor(play, kind, values)
	  Drive.step(play, elapsed)   every record to where the play's clock holds it
	Size and Color affect particles already out, Rate and SpreadAngle only new ones. A sequence write
	allocates, so Size and Color are rebuilt only when they moved by a step.
]]

local Clock = require(script.Parent.Clock)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Colors)
local Fade = require(script.Parent.Fade)
local Lines = require(script.Parent.Lines)
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local TypeData = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeRegistry.TypeData)

local DRIVE_GRAPHS = TypeData.ContainerDriveGraphs

-- A new Size when the scale moved by this share; a new Color when a channel moved by this much.
local SCALE_STEP = 0.005
local COLOR_STEP = 1 / 128
local NO_SKIPS = {}
-- For a play made with no surfaces (offline cases).
local NO_RECORDS = {}

local Drive = {}

local function hasTransformedAncestor(instance, root)
	local parent = instance.Parent
	while parent and parent ~= root do
		if parent:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			return true
		end
		parent = parent.Parent
	end
	return false
end

function Drive.collect(copy)
	local records = {}
	for _, descendant in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and not hasTransformedAncestor(descendant, copy) then
			table.insert(records, {
				emitter = descendant,
				timing = {
					delay = math.max(tonumber(descendant:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0, 0),
					duration = Clock.maxDuration(descendant:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")),
					life = descendant.Lifetime.Max,
				},
				base = {
					rate = descendant.Rate,
					size = descendant.Size,
					transparency = descendant.Transparency,
					timeScale = descendant.TimeScale,
					brightness = descendant.Brightness,
					color = descendant.Color,
					spread = descendant.SpreadAngle,
					lightInfluence = descendant.LightInfluence,
					lightEmission = descendant.LightEmission,
				},
			})
		end
	end
	return records
end

-- What a Container asks of something it does not write itself: neutral until the first step.
local function newAsked(kind, instance, life, fadeKind)
	return {
		kind = kind,
		fadeKind = fadeKind,
		timing = {
			delay = math.max(tonumber(instance:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0, 0),
			duration = Clock.maxDuration(instance:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")),
			life = life,
		},
		rate = 1,
		scale = 1,
		timescale = 1,
		brightness = 1,
		spreadX = 0,
		spreadY = 0,
		lightInfluence = 0,
		lightEmission = 0,
		look = nil,
		colorStamp = 0,
		transparency = 0,
	}
end

function Drive.collectLines(copy)
	local records = {}
	for _, descendant in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
		local kind = Lines.kindOf(descendant)
		if kind and not descendant:GetAttribute("Transformed") and not hasTransformedAncestor(descendant, copy) then
			local life = 0
			if kind == "Trail" then
				life = descendant.Lifetime
			end
			local record = newAsked(kind, descendant, life, kind)
			record.line = descendant
			record.base = Lines.base(descendant, kind)
			record.state = {}
			table.insert(records, record)
		end
	end
	return records
end

-- Whether an instance is something Transparency fades in a copy, and its kind: Part or Effect.
local function surfaceKind(instance)
	if instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Decal") then
		return "Part"
	end
	if instance:IsA("Light") or instance:IsA("Highlight") then
		return "Effect"
	end
	return nil
end

function Drive.collectSurfaces(root, leaveOut)
	local records = {}
	local function take(instance)
		local kind = surfaceKind(instance)
		if not kind or (leaveOut and leaveOut[instance]) or hasTransformedAncestor(instance, root) then
			return
		end
		local base = {}
		if instance:IsA("Light") then
			base.brightness = instance.Brightness
		elseif instance:IsA("Highlight") then
			base.fill = instance.FillTransparency
			base.outline = instance.OutlineTransparency
		else
			base.transparency = instance.Transparency
		end
		table.insert(records, { surface = instance, kind = kind, base = base })
	end
	take(root)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		take(descendant)
	end
	return records
end

-- Writes a surface's own value faded, when the fade moved since the last write.
local function fadeSurface(record, fade)
	if not Fade.moved(record.appliedFade or 0, fade) then
		return
	end
	record.appliedFade = fade
	local surface = record.surface
	local base = record.base
	if base.brightness then
		surface.Brightness = Fade.light(base.brightness, fade)
	elseif base.fill then
		surface.FillTransparency = Fade.number(base.fill, fade)
		surface.OutlineTransparency = Fade.number(base.outline, fade)
	else
		surface.Transparency = Fade.number(base.transparency, fade)
	end
end

function Drive.collectCarried(renderTemplate, readLifetime, typeOf)
	local records = {}
	local byItem = {}
	local function visit(node)
		for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
			if child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				local lifetime = readLifetime(child)
				local life = 0
				if typeof(lifetime) == "NumberRange" then
					life = lifetime.Max
				end
				local kind = Lines.kindOf(child) or "Mesh"
				if child:GetAttribute("IsForce") == true then
					kind = "Reactor"
				end
				-- Without a type, what the other graphs call it; a Force draws nothing to fade.
				local fadeKind = kind
				if typeOf then
					fadeKind = Fade.KIND_OF_TYPE[typeOf(child)]
				elseif kind == "Reactor" then
					fadeKind = nil
				end
				local record = newAsked(kind, child, life, fadeKind)
				record.item = child
				if child:GetAttribute("IsContainer") == true then
					record.isContainer = true
					record.fadeByKind = {}
					record.fadeStamp = 0
				end
				table.insert(records, record)
				byItem[child] = record
			else
				visit(child)
			end
		end
	end
	visit(renderTemplate)
	return records, byItem
end

local function isNeutral(graph, neutral)
	for _, keypoint in ipairs(graph.Keypoints) do
		if keypoint.Value ~= neutral or keypoint.Envelope ~= 0 then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Drive.activeGraphs(graphs)
	local active = {}
	for key, kind in pairs(DRIVE_GRAPHS) do
		local graph = graphs[key]
		local neutral = 0
		if kind == "multiply" then
			neutral = 1
		end
		if graph and not isNeutral(graph, neutral) then
			active[key] = graph
		end
	end
	return active
end

function Drive.lowestTimescale(graphs)
	local lowestFactor = 1
	local graph = graphs.DriveTimescale
	if graph then
		for _, keypoint in ipairs(graph.Keypoints) do
			lowestFactor = math.min(lowestFactor, math.max(keypoint.Value - keypoint.Envelope, 0))
		end
	end
	return lowestFactor
end

function Drive.slowestTimescale(records, graphs)
	local lowestFactor = Drive.lowestTimescale(graphs)
	local slowest = 1
	for _, record in ipairs(records) do
		slowest = math.min(slowest, record.base.timeScale * lowestFactor)
	end
	return slowest
end

function Drive.colorGraph(sequence, mode)
	if typeof(sequence) ~= "ColorSequence" or Colors.isNeutral(sequence, mode) then
		return nil
	end
	return sequence
end

local function colorMoved(last, now)
	return math.abs(now.R - last.R) > COLOR_STEP or math.abs(now.G - last.G) > COLOR_STEP or math.abs(now.B - last.B) > COLOR_STEP
end

function Drive.fadeFor(play, kind, values)
	local own = 0
	local skips = play.Skips and play.Skips[kind]
	if not (skips and skips.DriveTransparency) then
		own = math.clamp(values.DriveTransparency or 0, 0, 1)
	end
	local outer = play._outer
	local outerFade = outer and outer.fadeByKind and outer.fadeByKind[kind]
	if outerFade then
		return Fade.combine(own, outerFade)
	end
	return own
end

function Drive.apply(record, values, play)
	local emitter = record.emitter
	local base = record.base
	local skips = NO_SKIPS
	if play and play.Skips then
		skips = play.Skips.Emitter
	end

	if play then
		local fade = Drive.fadeFor(play, "Emitter", values)
		if Fade.moved(record.appliedFade or 0, fade) then
			record.appliedFade = fade
			emitter.Transparency = Fade.sequence(base.transparency, fade)
		end
	end

	local rateFactor = values.DriveRate
	if rateFactor and not skips.DriveRate then
		emitter.Rate = base.rate * math.max(rateFactor, 0)
	end

	local scale = values.DriveScale
	if scale and not skips.DriveScale then
		scale = math.max(scale, 0)
		local last = record.appliedScale
		if last == nil or math.abs(scale - last) > SCALE_STEP * math.max(last, SCALE_STEP) then
			record.appliedScale = scale
			emitter.Size = Lines.scaled(base.size, scale)
		end
	end

	local timeFactor = values.DriveTimescale
	if timeFactor and not skips.DriveTimescale then
		emitter.TimeScale = math.clamp(base.timeScale * timeFactor, 0, 1)
	end

	local brightnessFactor = values.DriveBrightness
	if brightnessFactor and not skips.DriveBrightness then
		emitter.Brightness = base.brightness * math.max(brightnessFactor, 0)
	end

	local driven = play and play._color
	if driven and not skips.DriveColor then
		local last = record.appliedColor
		if last == nil or colorMoved(last, driven) then
			record.appliedColor = driven
			emitter.Color = Colors.apply(base.color, driven, play.ColorMode, play.ColorReference)
		end
	end

	local spreadX = values.DriveSpreadX
	local spreadY = values.DriveSpreadY
	if (spreadX or spreadY) and not skips.DriveSpreadX then
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(base.spread.X + (spreadX or 0), base.spread.Y + (spreadY or 0))
	end

	local influence = values.DriveLightInfluence
	if influence and not skips.DriveLightInfluence then
		emitter.LightInfluence = math.clamp(base.lightInfluence + influence, 0, 1)
	end

	local emission = values.DriveLightEmission
	if emission and not skips.DriveLightEmission then
		emitter.LightEmission = math.clamp(base.lightEmission + emission, 0, 1)
	end
end

-- The active graphs sampled at `position`, once per position (Absolute mode shares one).
local function sampleAt(play, position)
	if play._sampledPosition == position then
		return
	end
	play._sampledPosition = position
	local values = play._values
	for key, graph in pairs(play.ActiveGraphs) do
		values[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(position, graph, play.Seeds[key])
	end
	if play.ColorGraph then
		play._color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(position, play.ColorGraph)
	end
end

-- What the play asks now, put on a carried or line record; its kind picks its "Apply to".
local function ask(record, values, play)
	local skips = NO_SKIPS
	if play.Skips then
		skips = play.Skips[record.kind or "Mesh"] or NO_SKIPS
	end
	record.rate = 1
	record.scale = 1
	record.timescale = 1
	record.brightness = 1
	record.spreadX = 0
	record.spreadY = 0
	record.lightInfluence = 0
	record.lightEmission = 0
	-- For a Trail's Lifetime (Container/Lines.lifetimeAhead reads the graph forward).
	record.slowed = values.DriveTimescale ~= nil and not skips.DriveTimescale
	if not skips.DriveLightInfluence then
		record.lightInfluence = values.DriveLightInfluence or 0
	end
	if not skips.DriveLightEmission then
		record.lightEmission = values.DriveLightEmission or 0
	end
	if not skips.DriveRate then
		record.rate = math.max(values.DriveRate or 1, 0)
	end
	if not skips.DriveScale then
		record.scale = math.max(values.DriveScale or 1, 0)
	end
	if not skips.DriveTimescale then
		record.timescale = values.DriveTimescale or 1
	end
	if not skips.DriveBrightness then
		record.brightness = math.max(values.DriveBrightness or 1, 0)
	end
	if not skips.DriveSpreadX then
		record.spreadX = values.DriveSpreadX or 0
		record.spreadY = values.DriveSpreadY or 0
	end
	local driven = play._color
	if skips.DriveColor then
		driven = nil
	end
	if driven and (record.asked == nil or colorMoved(record.asked, driven)) then
		record.asked = driven
		record.look = Colors.prepare(record.look or {}, driven, play.ColorMode, play.ColorReference)
		record.colorStamp += 1
	end
	record.transparency = 0
	if record.fadeKind then
		record.transparency = Drive.fadeFor(play, record.fadeKind, values)
	end
	local byKind = record.fadeByKind
	if byKind then
		local changed = false
		for _, fadeKind in ipairs(Fade.KINDS) do
			local fade = Drive.fadeFor(play, fadeKind, values)
			if byKind[fadeKind] ~= fade then
				byKind[fadeKind] = fade
				changed = true
			end
		end
		if changed then
			record.fadeStamp += 1
		end
	end
end

-- One line record: what the play asks of its kind now, written to the Beam or Trail.
local function driveLine(record, play)
	record.play = play
	ask(record, play._values, play)
	Lines.write(record.line, record.kind, record.base, record, record.state)
end

-- A carried record's adopted emitters, lines or surfaces: gone ones leave the list, the others
-- take the play's values when the record moved.
local function driveAdopted(list, moved, play)
	local index = 1
	while index <= #list do
		local adopted = list[index]
		local instance = adopted.emitter or adopted.line or adopted.surface
		if instance.Parent == nil then
			list[index] = list[#list]
			list[#list] = nil
		else
			-- A Trail's Lifetime looks ahead, so it moves while its place on the graphs holds.
			if adopted.line and (moved or adopted.kind == "Trail") then
				driveLine(adopted, play)
			elseif moved and adopted.emitter then
				Drive.apply(adopted, play._values, play)
			elseif moved and adopted.surface then
				fadeSurface(adopted, Drive.fadeFor(play, adopted.kind, play._values))
			end
			index += 1
		end
	end
end

-- A slowed Container emits fewer particles per second, as a native emitter under a lower TimeScale does.
function Drive.stream(record, rate, dt)
	if not record then
		return rate, dt
	end
	return rate * record.rate, dt * math.max(record.timescale, 0)
end

function Drive.adopt(record, carriedPlay)
	local play = record and record.play
	if not play or play._released or not play._drives then
		return 0
	end
	if carriedPlay.IsAnimate or carriedPlay.Type == "Container" or not carriedPlay.VisualPart then
		return 0
	end
	local visual = carriedPlay.VisualPart
	local found = Drive.collect(visual)
	local lines = Drive.collectLines(visual)
	-- A mesh writes its own transparency and its decal layers' (UpdatePart, DecalLayers).
	local leaveOut = nil
	if carriedPlay.Type == "Part" then
		leaveOut = { [visual] = true }
		for _, child in ipairs(visual:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Decal") then
				leaveOut[child] = true
			end
		end
	end
	-- Plain parts and lights only from a play that fades; that copy stays out of the pool.
	local surfaces = NO_RECORDS
	if play._fades then
		surfaces = Drive.collectSurfaces(visual, leaveOut)
	end
	if #found + #lines + #surfaces == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	sampleAt(play, record.position or 0)
	record.emitters = record.emitters or {}
	for _, adopted in ipairs(found) do
		Drive.apply(adopted, play._values, play)
		table.insert(record.emitters, adopted)
	end
	record.lines = record.lines or {}
	for _, adopted in ipairs(lines) do
		-- On the carried item's clock, as its values are: a Trail reads the graph ahead by it.
		adopted.timing = record.timing
		driveLine(adopted, play)
		table.insert(record.lines, adopted)
	end
	record.surfaces = record.surfaces or {}
	for _, adopted in ipairs(surfaces) do
		fadeSurface(adopted, Drive.fadeFor(play, adopted.kind, play._values))
		table.insert(record.surfaces, adopted)
	end
	carriedPlay._noPool = true
	return #found + #lines + #surfaces
end

function Drive.step(play, elapsed)
	play._stepAt = elapsed
	-- The outer Container's fade changed: everything is written again with it.
	local outer = play._outer
	local refresh = false
	if outer and outer.fadeStamp ~= play._outerStamp then
		play._outerStamp = outer.fadeStamp
		refresh = true
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(play.Driven) do
		local position = Clock.position(play.Mode, elapsed, play.ContainerLife, record.timing)
		if refresh or position ~= record.position then
			record.position = position
			sampleAt(play, position)
			Drive.apply(record, play._values, play)
		end
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(play.Lines) do
		local position = Clock.position(play.Mode, elapsed, play.ContainerLife, record.timing)
		if refresh or position ~= record.position or record.kind == "Trail" then
			record.position = position
			sampleAt(play, position)
			driveLine(record, play)
		end
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(play.Surfaces or NO_RECORDS) do
		local position = Clock.position(play.Mode, elapsed, play.ContainerLife, play.SurfaceTiming)
		if refresh or position ~= record.position then
			record.position = position
			sampleAt(play, position)
			fadeSurface(record, Drive.fadeFor(play, record.kind, play._values))
		end
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(play.Carried) do
		local position = Clock.position(play.Mode, elapsed, play.ContainerLife, record.timing)
		local moved = refresh or position ~= record.position
		if moved then
			record.position = position
			sampleAt(play, position)
			ask(record, play._values, play)
		end
		if record.emitters then
			driveAdopted(record.emitters, moved, play)
		end
		if record.surfaces then
			if not moved then
				sampleAt(play, position)
			end
			driveAdopted(record.surfaces, moved, play)
		end
		if record.lines then
			if not moved then
				sampleAt(play, position)
			end
			driveAdopted(record.lines, moved, play)
		end
	end
end

return Drive
