--[[
	Container/Fade: a Container's Transparency as each thing it holds takes it. Opacities multiply, so
	a group fades evenly and keeps its own look: shown = 1 - (1 - own) * (1 - fade). A fade of 0 changes
	nothing, 1 hides everything, 0.5 halves every opacity; a hidden thing stays hidden. A light dims by
	the same opacity.
	  Fade.KINDS                       what the Transparency row's "Apply to" lists (TypeDataContainer.APPLY_KINDS has them too)
	  Fade.KIND_OF_TYPE[typeName]      the kind a carried part-icle's own fade answers to; a type without
	                                   one is faded through what its copy holds (Model, Attachment) or draws nothing
	  Fade.combine(first, second)      two fades on top of each other (a Container inside one)
	  Fade.number(own, fade)           a transparency faded
	  Fade.light(brightness, fade)     a light's brightness dimmed
	  Fade.sequence(sequence, fade)    a NumberSequence faded, each envelope narrowed alike
	  Fade.moved(last, now)            whether a fade moved enough to build a sequence again
	  Fade.of(record)                  the fade a carried record asks for, 0 without one
	  Fade.fading(record)              whether the Container's play behind a record fades at all: a visual it
	                                   fades is kept out of the pool (pData._noPool), or the next play would
	                                   take the faded value as its own
	Requires nothing: the update of every type that draws reads it.
]]

local Fade = {}

-- A sequence is built again when the fade moved by this much.
local STEP = 1 / 256

Fade.KINDS = { "Emitter", "Mesh", "Beam", "Trail", "Part", "Effect" }

Fade.KIND_OF_TYPE = {
	Part = "Mesh",
	Beam = "Beam",
	TrailEmitter = "Trail",
	Highlight = "Effect",
	Lightning = "Effect",
	Rope = "Effect",
	Rocks = "Effect",
	Matte = "Effect",
	Distortion = "Effect",
	ImageLabel = "Effect",
	PointLight = "Effect",
}

function Fade.combine(first, second)
	return 1 - (1 - first) * (1 - second)
end

function Fade.number(own, fade)
	return 1 - (1 - own) * (1 - fade)
end

function Fade.light(brightness, fade)
	return brightness * (1 - fade)
end

function Fade.sequence(sequence, fade)
	local keep = 1 - fade
	local keypoints = {}
	for index, keypoint in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints) do
		keypoints[index] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(keypoint.Time, 1 - (1 - keypoint.Value) * keep, keypoint.Envelope * keep)
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
end

function Fade.moved(last, now)
	return last == nil or math.abs(now - last) > STEP or (now == 0) ~= (last == 0)
end

function Fade.of(record)
	return record and record.transparency or 0
end

function Fade.fading(record)
	return record ~= nil and record.play ~= nil and record.play._fades == true
end

return Fade

--[[
	Container/Lines  -  what a Container asks of a Beam or a Trail: a native one in a copy, or the
	emitted visual of a transformed Beam or Trail the Container carries.

	             Beam                      Trail
	  Scale      Width0, Width1            WidthScale
	  Timescale  TextureSpeed              Lifetime (a slowed trail lasts longer, a stopped one stays)
	  Brightness Brightness                Brightness
	  Light +    LightInfluence and LightEmission, kept within 0..1
	  Color      Color, through the Container's look (Container/Colors)
	  Transparency  Transparency, faded (Container/Fade)
	Rate and Spread mean nothing to either. A transformed one's stream takes the Rate in
	Lifecycle's Enable loop, and its own clock the Timescale (UpdateBeam, UpdateTrail).

	  Lines.kindOf(instance) -> "Beam" | "Trail" | nil
	  Lines.base(line, kind) -> the values the line has now, to drive from
	  Lines.scaled(sequence, factor) -> NumberSequence, every value and envelope multiplied
	  Lines.lifetimeAhead(state, asked, lifetime) -> seconds: the Lifetime to give a trail now
	  Lines.write(line, kind, base, asked, state)
	      asked: a record as Container/Drive keeps it. state: a table the caller keeps for this
	      line; a sequence is built again only when its source or what is asked has moved.
	  Lines.carry(pData, kind, asked)
	      at the emit of a transformed Beam or Trail a Container carries: keeps the record and
	      the visual's values on the play, and keeps the visual out of the pool.
	  Lines.driveBeam(pData) / Lines.driveTrail(pData)
	      for UpdateBeam and UpdateTrail, once they have written what the item's own graphs ask
	      this frame: that is read back as the base, with pData._driveBase for a property no
	      graph of the item's own rewrites.

	A segment keeps the Lifetime it was born with: raising Lifetime later never lengthens a
	segment already drawn, and lowering it ages the drawn ones faster. So a segment is BORN with
	the life it will need: lifetimeAhead reads the Timescale graph forward until the trail's own
	lifetime of slowed time has passed (at most the engine's 20 s). While the timescale is nearly
	0 the Lifetime is not lowered, which would age the held segments.

	Mutates the line it is given, always a CLONE (a copy's Beam or Trail, an emitted visual),
	never one in a RenderTemplate.
	Cross-file: driveBeam and driveTrail know what UpdateBeam and UpdateTrail rewrite each frame
	(AnimatedProps, ParentScale, the blender states) and that a Trail's scalar graphs are only
	written when its step changes, so they are sampled again here.
]]

local Clock = require(script.Parent.Clock)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Colors)
local Fade = require(script.Parent.Fade)
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)

-- The engine keeps a Trail's Lifetime within this.
local LONGEST_TRAIL = 20
local SHORTEST_TRAIL = 0.01
-- A new WidthScale sequence when the scale moved by this share of itself.
local SCALE_STEP = 0.005
local AHEAD_STEP = 1 / 30
-- Under this timescale a trail's Lifetime is never lowered.
local HOLD_BELOW = 0.25

local Lines = {}

function Lines.kindOf(instance)
	if instance:IsA("Beam") then
		return "Beam"
	end
	if instance:IsA("Trail") then
		return "Trail"
	end
	return nil
end

function Lines.base(line, kind)
	local base = {
		brightness = line.Brightness,
		lightInfluence = line.LightInfluence,
		lightEmission = line.LightEmission,
		color = line.Color,
		transparency = line.Transparency,
	}
	if kind == "Beam" then
		base.width0 = line.Width0
		base.width1 = line.Width1
		base.curveSize0 = line.CurveSize0
		base.curveSize1 = line.CurveSize1
		base.textureSpeed = line.TextureSpeed
	else
		base.widthScale = line.WidthScale
		base.lifetime = line.Lifetime
	end
	return base
end

function Lines.scaled(sequence, factor)
	local keypoints = {}
	for index, keypoint in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints) do
		keypoints[index] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(keypoint.Time, keypoint.Value * factor, keypoint.Envelope * factor)
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
end

local function timescaleAt(asked, at)
	local play = asked.play
	local position = Clock.position(play.Mode, at, play.ContainerLife, asked.timing)
	return math.max(GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(position, play.ActiveGraphs.DriveTimescale, play.Seeds.DriveTimescale), 0)
end

-- Slowed time is summed in fixed slices from where the trail was first seen. Both ends only
-- move forward and a slice read twice gives the same value, so nothing drifts.
function Lines.lifetimeAhead(state, asked, lifetime)
	local play = asked.play
	local now = play._stepAt or 0
	if state.aheadFor ~= lifetime or now < state.nowSlice * AHEAD_STEP then
		state.aheadFor = lifetime
		state.nowSlice = math.floor(now / AHEAD_STEP)
		state.nowSum = 0
		state.endSlice = state.nowSlice
		state.endSum = 0
	end
	while (state.nowSlice + 1) * AHEAD_STEP <= now do
		state.nowSum += timescaleAt(asked, (state.nowSlice + 0.5) * AHEAD_STEP) * AHEAD_STEP
		state.nowSlice += 1
	end
	local passed = state.nowSum + (now - state.nowSlice * AHEAD_STEP) * timescaleAt(asked, (state.nowSlice + 0.5) * AHEAD_STEP)
	if state.endSlice < state.nowSlice then
		state.endSlice = state.nowSlice
		state.endSum = state.nowSum
	end
	local last = 0
	while state.endSum - passed < lifetime and state.endSlice * AHEAD_STEP - now < LONGEST_TRAIL do
		last = timescaleAt(asked, (state.endSlice + 0.5) * AHEAD_STEP)
		state.endSum += last * AHEAD_STEP
		state.endSlice += 1
		state.endLast = last
	end
	local need = state.endSlice * AHEAD_STEP - now
	local over = state.endSum - passed - lifetime
	local closing = state.endLast or 0
	if over > 0 and closing > 0 then
		need -= over / closing
	end
	return math.clamp(need, SHORTEST_TRAIL, LONGEST_TRAIL)
end

-- The line's Transparency under the Container's fade. A faded sequence is kept until its source
-- or the fade moves; written every time, as a transformed line's update rewrites it each frame.
local function fadeLine(line, transparency, fade, state)
	if fade == 0 then
		if state.faded then
			state.faded = false
			state.fadeFrom = nil
			line.Transparency = transparency
		end
		return
	end
	if state.fadeFrom ~= transparency or Fade.moved(state.fade, fade) then
		state.fadeFrom = transparency
		state.fade = fade
		state.fadedSequence = Fade.sequence(transparency, fade)
	end
	state.faded = true
	line.Transparency = state.fadedSequence
end

local function trailLife(base, asked, state)
	if not asked.slowed then
		return base.lifetime
	end
	local need = Lines.lifetimeAhead(state, asked, base.lifetime)
	local held = state.lifetime
	if held and held > need and asked.timescale < HOLD_BELOW then
		need = held
	end
	state.lifetime = need
	return need
end

function Lines.write(line, kind, base, asked, state)
	local scale = asked.scale
	if kind == "Beam" then
		line.Width0 = base.width0 * scale
		line.Width1 = base.width1 * scale
		-- The curve grows with the beam: its attachments are set apart by the same Scale (NestedScale).
		if base.curveSize0 then
			line.CurveSize0 = base.curveSize0 * scale
			line.CurveSize1 = base.curveSize1 * scale
		end
		-- nil for a transformed Beam whose texture runs on its own clock (UpdateBeam).
		if base.textureSpeed then
			line.TextureSpeed = base.textureSpeed * asked.timescale
		end
	else
		local last = state.scale
		if state.widthFrom ~= base.widthScale or last == nil or math.abs(scale - last) > SCALE_STEP * math.max(last, SCALE_STEP) then
			state.widthFrom = base.widthScale
			state.scale = scale
			state.width = Lines.scaled(base.widthScale, scale)
		end
		line.WidthScale = state.width
		line.Lifetime = trailLife(base, asked, state)
	end
	line.Brightness = base.brightness * asked.brightness
	line.LightInfluence = math.clamp(base.lightInfluence + asked.lightInfluence, 0, 1)
	line.LightEmission = math.clamp(base.lightEmission + asked.lightEmission, 0, 1)

	-- base.color is nil while an event holds the line's colour (pData.SkipColor).
	local look = asked.look
	if look and base.color then
		if state.colorFrom ~= base.color or state.colorStamp ~= asked.colorStamp then
			state.colorFrom = base.color
			state.colorStamp = asked.colorStamp
			state.color = Colors.sequence(base.color, look)
		end
		line.Color = state.color
	end

	-- base.transparency is nil while an event holds the line's transparency (pData.SkipTransparency).
	if base.transparency then
		fadeLine(line, base.transparency, asked.transparency or 0, state)
	end
end

local function hasStates(states)
	return states ~= nil and #states >= 1
end

function Lines.driveBeam(pData)
	local beam = pData.VisualPart
	local base = pData._driveBase
	local animated = pData.AnimatedProps
	local authored = pData._driveAuthored
	local rescaled = pData.ParentScale ~= nil
	authored.width0 = (animated.Width0 or rescaled) and beam.Width0 or base.width0
	authored.width1 = (animated.Width1 or rescaled) and beam.Width1 or base.width1
	authored.curveSize0 = (animated.CurveSize0 or rescaled) and beam.CurveSize0 or base.curveSize0
	authored.curveSize1 = (animated.CurveSize1 or rescaled) and beam.CurveSize1 or base.curveSize1
	authored.brightness = animated.Brightness and beam.Brightness or base.brightness
	authored.lightInfluence = animated.LightInfluence and beam.LightInfluence or base.lightInfluence
	authored.lightEmission = animated.LightEmission and beam.LightEmission or base.lightEmission
	authored.textureSpeed = nil
	if not animated.TextureSpeed then
		authored.textureSpeed = base.textureSpeed
	end
	authored.color = base.color
	if pData.SkipColor then
		authored.color = nil
	elseif hasStates(pData.ColorStates) then
		authored.color = beam.Color
	end
	authored.transparency = base.transparency
	if pData.SkipTransparency then
		authored.transparency = nil
	elseif hasStates(pData.TransStates) then
		authored.transparency = beam.Transparency
	end
	Lines.write(beam, "Beam", authored, pData._drive, pData._driveState)
end

function Lines.driveTrail(pData)
	local trail = pData.VisualPart
	local base = pData._driveBase
	local authored = pData._driveAuthored
	local blended = not pData.SkipColor
	authored.widthScale = base.widthScale
	if blended and hasStates(pData.WidthStates) then
		authored.widthScale = trail.WidthScale
	end
	authored.color = base.color
	if not blended then
		authored.color = nil
	elseif hasStates(pData.ColorStates) then
		authored.color = trail.Color
	end
	authored.transparency = base.transparency
	if pData.SkipTransparency then
		authored.transparency = nil
	elseif hasStates(pData.TransStates) then
		authored.transparency = trail.Transparency
	end
	authored.lifetime = base.lifetime

	local graphs = pData.Graphs
	local seeds = pData.Seeds
	local stepped = pData.CurrentStep / math.max(pData.TotalKeyFrames, 1)
	authored.brightness = base.brightness
	if graphs.Brightness then
		authored.brightness = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(stepped, graphs.Brightness, seeds.Brightness)
	end
	authored.lightInfluence = base.lightInfluence
	if graphs.LightInfluence then
		authored.lightInfluence = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(stepped, graphs.LightInfluence, seeds.LightInfluence)
	end
	authored.lightEmission = base.lightEmission
	if graphs.LightEmission then
		authored.lightEmission = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(stepped, graphs.LightEmission, seeds.LightEmission)
	end
	Lines.write(trail, "Trail", authored, pData._drive, pData._driveState)
end

-- The visual is destroyed at release (pData._noPool). Never called for an Animate play, whose
-- visual is the live RenderTemplate. The first write is made here.
function Lines.carry(pData, kind, asked)
	pData._drive = asked
	pData._driveBase = Lines.base(pData.VisualPart, kind)
	pData._driveAuthored = {}
	pData._driveState = {}
	pData._noPool = true
	if kind == "Beam" then
		Lines.driveBeam(pData)
	else
		Lines.driveTrail(pData)
	end
end

return Lines

--[[
	DecalLayers  -  per-decal appearance + flipbook for Part visuals ("decal layers").

	Each Decal / Texture directly under the RenderTemplate is a layer, identified by its name (an
	occurrence index breaks ties). Layer settings are attributes on that RT decal:
	  LayerTransparency / LayerColor / LayerBrightness  graphs over life (nil = 0 / authored Color3 / 1)
	  LayerFlipbook       name of a MeshFlipbooks sub-folder; nil = the first layer takes the flat
	                      frames, "None" = no flipbook
	  LayerFlipbookMode / LayerFlipbookFramerate / LayerFlipbookStartRandom / LayerFlipbookReverse
	                      nil = inherit the part-level Flipbook settings
	  LayerActive         inventory insert target (UI only)
	On a Part + SpecialMesh visual with textured mesh frames the first decal's texture is written by
	Modules/Part/MeshFrames per mesh frame, so that layer runs no flipbook of its own.
	MeshFlipbooks holds one sub-folder of numbered frames per flipbook; numbered frames directly in
	the folder are the flat single flipbook (set "").

	Config attribute DecalLayers (Transform stamps true) selects the mode: true = the part's
	Transparency / Color / Brightness graphs drive the MESH and layers drive their decals; false / nil
	= the part graphs drive the first decal. Emit / EmitAnimate / Update branch on
	data.DecalLayersMode / pData.DecalLayersMode.

	Mutates CLONE decals (Emit) or the LIVE RT decals (Animate: snapshot at attach, restore() on
	finish and cancel). refresh() re-reads graphs per AnimateLoop cycle. write() allocates nothing
	but the Color3 it assigns.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local MeshFlipMod = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)
local ContainerColors = require(script.Parent.Container.Colors)
local ContainerFade = require(script.Parent.Container.Fade)

local DecalLayers = {}

local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

local function isLayerInstance(inst)
	return inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture")
end

-- Ordered layer descriptors from the RT's direct Decal / Texture children.
local function readLayers(rt)
	local layers = {}
	if not rt then return layers end
	local seen = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(rt:GetChildren()) do
		if not isLayerInstance(child) then continue end
		seen[child.Name] = (seen[child.Name] or 0) + 1
		local color = child:GetAttribute("LayerColor")
		if typeof(color) ~= "ColorSequence" then color = ColorSequence.new(child.Color3) end
		table.insert(layers, {
			name = child.Name,
			occurrence = seen[child.Name],
			texture = child.Texture,
			transparency = child:GetAttribute("LayerTransparency"),
			color = color,
			brightness = child:GetAttribute("LayerBrightness"),
			flipbook = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbook"),
			mode = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbookMode"),
			framerate = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbookFramerate"),
			startRandom = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbookStartRandom"),
			reverse = child:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbookReverse"),
		})
	end
	return layers
end

-- GetData hook: mode flag, flipbook sets, layer descriptors. CachedMeshTextures keeps the flat set
-- (or the first sub-folder by name) for SurfaceAppearance, MeshPart and legacy targets.
function DecalLayers.readInto(data, item, config)
	data.DecalLayersMode = config:GetAttribute("DecalLayers") == true
	data.MeshFlipbooks = item:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks")
	data.MeshFlipbookSets = data.MeshFlipbooks and MeshFlipMod.GetFlipbookSets(data.MeshFlipbooks) or {}
	data.CachedMeshTextures = data.MeshFlipbookSets[""]
	if not data.CachedMeshTextures then
		local names = {}
		for name in pairs(data.MeshFlipbookSets) do table.insert(names, name) end
		table.sort(names)
		if names[1] then data.CachedMeshTextures = data.MeshFlipbookSets[names[1]] end
	end
	data.DecalLayers = data.DecalLayersMode and readLayers(item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")) or {}
end

-- Frames for a layer: its assigned sub-folder, or the legacy flat set for an unassigned first layer.
local function framesFor(data, layer, index)
	local key = layer.flipbook
	if key == "None" then return nil end
	if key == nil or key == "" then
		if index == 1 then return data.MeshFlipbookSets[""] end
		return nil
	end
	return data.MeshFlipbookSets[key]
end

-- Bind descriptors to the visual's decals (name + occurrence), write t=0 and start the flipbooks.
-- liveSource = Animate on the RT itself: snapshot for restore(), never cycle textures on it.
function DecalLayers.attach(pData, data, visualPart, lifetime, liveSource)
	pData.Layers = nil
	local descriptors = data.DecalLayers
	if not data.DecalLayersMode or not descriptors or #descriptors == 0 then return end
	local particle = data.ParticleData
	local byKey = {}
	for index, desc in ipairs(descriptors) do byKey[desc.name .. "#" .. desc.occurrence] = index end
	local meshFramesOwnFirst = data.MeshFramesTextured == true and visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") ~= nil
	local seen = {}
	local layers = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(visualPart:GetChildren()) do
		if not isLayerInstance(child) then continue end
		seen[child.Name] = (seen[child.Name] or 0) + 1
		local index = byKey[child.Name .. "#" .. seen[child.Name]]
		local desc = index and descriptors[index]
		if not desc then continue end
		local entry = {
			decal = child,
			transparency = desc.transparency, color = desc.color, brightness = desc.brightness,
			transparencySeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(desc.transparency),
			brightnessSeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(desc.brightness),
		}
		if liveSource then
			entry.snapshot = { transparency = child.Transparency, color = child.Color3, texture = child.Texture }
		elseif meshFramesOwnFirst and index == 1 then
			-- Texture written per mesh frame by MeshFrames.
		else
			local frames = framesFor(data, desc, index)
			local mode = desc.mode or (particle.FlipbookMode and particle.FlipbookMode.Name) or "None"
			if frames and #frames > 0 and mode ~= "None" then
				local framerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(desc.framerate or particle.FlipbookFramerate or NumberRange.new(30))
				local startRandom = desc.startRandom
				if startRandom == nil then startRandom = particle.FlipbookStartRandom end
				local reverse = desc.reverse
				if reverse == nil then reverse = particle.FlipbookReverse end
				entry.flip = MeshFlipMod.layerState(child, frames, mode, framerate, startRandom, reverse)
			else
				-- A pooled clone may still show the previous emit's last frame.
				child.Texture = desc.texture
			end
		end
		table.insert(layers, entry)
	end
	if #layers == 0 then return end
	pData.Layers = layers
	DecalLayers.write(pData, 0)
	if not liveSource then MeshFlipMod.FlipLayers(pData, layers, lifetime) end
end

-- Stepped write at normalized life t; honours the event payload's SkipTransparency / SkipColor.
function DecalLayers.write(pData, t)
	local layers = pData.Layers
	if not layers then return end
	for i = 1, #layers do
		local layer = layers[i]
		local decal = layer.decal
		local trans = layer.transparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, layer.transparency, layer.transparencySeed) or 0
		local bright = layer.brightness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, layer.brightness, layer.brightnessSeed) or 1
		local color = layer.color and GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, layer.color) or WHITE
		-- Carried by a Container (pData._drive): every layer takes its brightness, its colour and its fade.
		local drive = pData._drive
		if drive then
			bright = bright * drive.brightness
			if drive.look then color = ContainerColors.driven(layer, color, drive) end
			if drive.transparency ~= 0 then trans = ContainerFade.number(trans, drive.transparency) end
		end
		if not pData.SkipTransparency then decal.Transparency = trans end
		if not pData.SkipColor then
			decal.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255 * bright, color.G * 255 * bright, color.B * 255 * bright)
		end
	end
end

-- Animate finish / cancel: put the live RT decals back exactly as attach() found them.
function DecalLayers.restore(pData)
	local layers = pData.Layers
	if not layers then return end
	for i = 1, #layers do
		local layer = layers[i]
		local snap = layer.snapshot
		if snap and layer.decal.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				layer.decal.Transparency = snap.transparency
				layer.decal.Color3 = snap.color
				layer.decal.Texture = snap.texture
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- AnimateLoop cycle: re-read the graphs (and roll fresh envelope seeds) for the bound decals.
function DecalLayers.refresh(pData, freshData)
	local layers = pData.Layers
	if not layers or not freshData.DecalLayers then return end
	local byKey = {}
	for _, desc in ipairs(freshData.DecalLayers) do byKey[desc.name .. "#" .. desc.occurrence] = desc end
	local seen = {}
	for i = 1, #layers do
		local layer = layers[i]
		local name = layer.decal.Name
		seen[name] = (seen[name] or 0) + 1
		local desc = byKey[name .. "#" .. seen[name]]
		if desc then
			layer.transparency, layer.color, layer.brightness = desc.transparency, desc.color, desc.brightness
			layer.transparencySeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(desc.transparency)
			layer.brightnessSeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(desc.brightness)
		end
	end
end

return DecalLayers

--[[
	Distortion mixin: Emit + Animate + Update for screen-space distortion emitters (glass canvas
	fields: Ripple / Wave / Noise / Bulge / Pinch).

	No visual clone: pData.VisualPart is nil (every engine teardown path guards it, as for
	CameraShake). Each live effect projects its epicenter to the screen, samples its Amplitude
	envelope (step-gated), integrates phase from effective time (Timescale-reversible) and pushes ONE
	contribution into Distortion/Canvas; Engine composites all contributions onto the shared glass
	plane once per step, AFTER CameraShakeApply.

	Nested emitters under a Distortion RenderTemplate never fire (no clone to link); a Distortion as a
	nested child of a Part/Model works and its epicenter rides the parent clone.

	Limits: desktop graphics quality about 8 and up; transparent objects behind the canvas are
	invisible while a distortion is active, so design for short bursts.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local ContainerFade = require(script.Parent.Container.Fade)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Canvas = require(script.Canvas)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

local KIND_IDS = { Ripple = 1, Wave = 2, Noise = 3, Bulge = 4, Pinch = 5 }

local warnedServer = false

return function(Particle)

-- Shared by the Emit dispatch in init.luau and the EmitAnimate dispatch in Lifecycle.
function Particle._isDistortion(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") == true
end

local function buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	local seeds = {
		Amplitude = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Amplitude),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	local eff0 = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime)
	local speed = data.Speed or 3
	local pData = {
		Type = "Distortion",
		VisualPart = nil,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = -1,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = 0,
		_sourceItem = item,
		Graphs = {
			Amplitude = data.Amplitude,
			Transparency = data.Transparency,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = eff0,
		_kindId = KIND_IDS[data.FieldKind] or 1,
		_wavelength = math.max(data.Wavelength or 1.5, 0.02),
		_speed = speed,
		_dirRad = math.rad(data.Direction or 0),
		_noiseScale = math.max(data.NoiseScale or 2, 0.05),
		_lensRadius = math.max(data.LensRadius or 1.5, 0.02),
		_screenCenter = data.EpicenterMode == "ScreenCenter",
		_falloff = data.Falloff or 0,
		_strength = data.Strength or 1,
		_amplify = data.Amplify or 0,
		_allowOver = data.AllowOverdrive == true,
		-- Mesh grid width request; the shared plane takes the highest active.
		_resolution = math.clamp(math.floor(data.Resolution or 24), 8, 96),
		-- Seeded from the initial effective time so a reverse-start Timescale plays the field backward
		-- from its END state, not from a negative radius.
		_phase = eff0 * speed * 0.1,
		_noiseSeed = math.floor(math.random() * 100000),
		_lastOriginPos = item.Position,
		-- Carried by a Container: its record, for Transparency (Container/Fade).
		_drive = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive or nil,
	}
	-- Event origin override (EnableEmitAt, Events AtPosition): the epicenter projects from it for the
	-- effect's whole life.
	if emitCtx then
		local originCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		originCF = originCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if originCF then pData._originOverride = originCF.Position end
		-- Carried by a Container or a Matte: its place on the parent clone (NestedEmit.keepPlace).
		if emitCtx._rigPlace then pData._parentPlace = emitCtx._rigPlace.Position end
	end
	return pData
end

function Particle:EmitDistortion(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	-- The server has no camera or screen.
	if not RunService:IsClient() then
		if not warnedServer then
			warnedServer = true
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Distortion ignored on the server (no screen).")
		end
		return
	end
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	if not data then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local pData = buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	-- Nested emit: the epicenter rides the emitted parent clone.
	pData._parentLink = link
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Animate mode: one persistent field per source, no clone.
function Particle:EmitDistortionAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	if not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	if not data then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local pData = buildPData(item, data, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	pData._parentLink = link
	pData.IsAnimate = true
	pData.AnimateItem = item

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Per frame: envelope (step-gated), phase integral, epicenter projection, then one Canvas
-- contribution. Allocates nothing.
function Particle:UpdateDistortion(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale header: see Lightning/init.luau UpdateLightning.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local newEff = (pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)
	if isDying then return true end

	-- Phase integral (Speed is signed, so reverse Timescale rewinds); 0.1 keeps Speed in 1 to 10.
	if not pData._timeFrozen then
		pData._phase += dtTs * pData._speed * 0.1
	end

	-- Envelope, step-gated by TotalKeyFrames.
	local li = newEff / lifeTime
	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(li, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local si = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		pData._curAmp = pData.Graphs.Amplitude and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Amplitude, pData.Seeds.Amplitude) or 0
		-- Above 1 is an overdrive request (effective about 4 to 10).
		local trans = pData.Graphs.Transparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Transparency, pData.Seeds.Transparency)
		pData._curTrans = trans and math.clamp(trans, 0, 10) or nil
		-- A Container's Transparency fades the field, which then never overdrives.
		local fade = ContainerFade.of(pData._drive)
		if fade ~= 0 then
			pData._curTrans = ContainerFade.number(math.clamp(trans or 0, 0, 1), fade)
		end
	end

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return false end

	-- Epicenter: screen centre, or the live world origin projected each frame (override, parent clone,
	-- source, then last known).
	local epicU, epicV = 0.5, 0.5
	local atten = 1
	if not pData._screenCenter or pData._falloff > 0 then
		local origin = pData._originOverride
		if not origin then
			local link = pData._parentLink
			if link and link.Parent then
				origin = Constants.placeOnLink(link, pData._parentPlace)
			else
				local src = pData._sourceItem
				origin = (src and src.Parent) and src.Position or pData._lastOriginPos
			end
		end
		pData._lastOriginPos = origin
		if pData._falloff > 0 then
			atten = math.clamp(1 - (cam.CFrame.Position - origin).Magnitude / pData._falloff, 0, 1)
		end
		if not pData._screenCenter then
			local vp, _ = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(origin)
			local vps = cam.ViewportSize
			epicU = vp.X / math.max(1, vps.X)
			-- Canvas V runs bottom-up, viewport Y top-down.
			epicV = 1 - vp.Y / math.max(1, vps.Y)
			-- Fades behind the camera so there is no pop when the camera crosses the epicenter plane.
			atten *= math.clamp(vp.Z / 2, 0, 1)
		end
	end

	-- Contributes every live frame, even at amp 0: the transparency channel must stay continuous
	-- through zero crossings and fades, or the plane blinks. Canvas pulls transparency toward 1 by atten.
	local amp = (pData._curAmp or 0) * pData._strength * atten
	Canvas.accumulate(pData._kindId, amp, pData._wavelength, pData._phase,
		pData._dirRad, pData._noiseScale, pData._lensRadius,
		epicU, epicV, pData._noiseSeed, pData._amplify, pData._allowOver,
		pData._curTrans, atten, pData._resolution)

	return false
end

-- AnimateLoop per-cycle refresh (EngineReplay dispatch): generic replay refreshes Graphs, seeds and
-- LifeTime; scalars are re-read here. EngineReplay calls _reseedDistortionPhase afterwards.
function Particle:_refreshDistortionAnimate(pData, freshData)
	pData.Link = nil
	pData._kindId = KIND_IDS[freshData.FieldKind] or 1
	pData._wavelength = math.max(freshData.Wavelength or 1.5, 0.02)
	pData._speed = freshData.Speed or 3
	pData._dirRad = math.rad(freshData.Direction or 0)
	pData._noiseScale = math.max(freshData.NoiseScale or 2, 0.05)
	pData._lensRadius = math.max(freshData.LensRadius or 1.5, 0.02)
	pData._screenCenter = freshData.EpicenterMode == "ScreenCenter"
	pData._falloff = freshData.Falloff or 0
	pData._strength = freshData.Strength or 1
	pData._amplify = freshData.Amplify or 0
	pData._allowOver = freshData.AllowOverdrive == true
	pData._resolution = math.clamp(math.floor(freshData.Resolution or 24), 8, 96)
	pData._curAmp = nil
	pData._curTrans = nil
	pData.CurrentStep = -1
end

-- Noise/Wave keep phase (continuous shimmer); Ripple/Bulge/Pinch restart from the initial effective
-- time so reverse-start loops play backward from the end. Must run AFTER EngineReplay recomputes
-- _effectiveElapsed (fresh Timescale graph, re-rolled LifeTime) or the phase seeds from the last cycle.
function Particle:_reseedDistortionPhase(pData)
	if pData._kindId == 1 or pData._kindId == 4 or pData._kindId == 5 then
		pData._phase = (pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) * pData._speed * 0.1
	end
end

end

--[[
	Distortion/Canvas  -  the one shared glass plane every Distortion draws on. Each live Distortion
	adds one contribution a frame (Canvas.accumulate, into preallocated arrays); Canvas.applyFrame,
	after the camera shake, sums them into the height field (Distortion/Field), locks the plane to the
	camera and writes its vertices once.
	One plane per client: overlapping glass culls itself. The plugin's engine and a game's module
	share it, first claimant wins (a heartbeat attribute); the other goes dormant.
	The plane's Transparency is the lowest of the contributions' (strongest glass wins); above 1 is
	the engine's overdrive, used only when every contribution allows it, and dropped for good if the
	engine ever clamps it. Idle, the plane turns SmoothPlastic with its Highlight off, since glass at
	Transparency 1 still shows a sheen.
]]

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local Field = require(script.Parent.Field)
local PlaneBuilder = require(script.Parent.PlaneBuilder)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.Parent.VisualHost)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Log)

local Canvas = {}

-- The mesh plane hugs the camera so little stands between; tile lenses stand farther, or they
-- would overlap and cull each other.
local MESH_DIST = 1
local TILE_DIST = 3.5
local MESH_OFFSET = CFrame.new(0, 0, -MESH_DIST)
local MARGIN = 1.15
-- Vertices never come nearer the camera than this, clear of the near clip.
local HEIGHT_CLAMP = MESH_DIST * 0.45
-- Displacement tapers to 0 across this band at the border, so the edges never show.
local EDGE_BAND = 0.12
-- Glass refracts the skybox, smearing the sun into a blob: the field lies flat in a hole around
-- the sun. Squared radii, in aspect-corrected UV.
local SUN_HOLE_IN2 = 0.09 * 0.09
local SUN_HOLE_OUT2 = 0.26 * 0.26
-- Amplitude is in slope units: height = amp * halfH * SLOPE_K looks alike at any FOV or resolution.
local SLOPE_K = 0.22
local IDLE_PARK_SECONDS = 2
local MAX_CONTRIB = 64
local BASE_TRANSPARENCY = 0.3
local HEARTBEAT_STALE = 1

-- Contributions (the cursor resets every frame).
local cKind = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cAmp = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cWavelength = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cPhase = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cDir = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cNoiseScale = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cLensRadius = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cEpicU = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cEpicV = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cSeed = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cAmplify = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cAllowOver = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cTrans = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cRes = table.create(MAX_CONTRIB)
local cursor = 0
local overflowWarned = false

local meshCanvas = nil          -- PlaneBuilder.buildMesh result
local tileCanvas = nil          -- PlaneBuilder.buildTiles result
local building = false
local meshTierAvailable = nil -- nil until probed
local overdriveLatched = false -- the engine clamped a value over 1: stay safe
local idleSince = nil
local dormant = false -- another engine owns the plane
local dormantWarned = false
local ownerSerial = math.floor((os.clock() % 1000) * 1000000)
local height = nil              -- sized per mesh build (resolution-dependent)
local tileHeight = table.create(PlaneBuilder.TILE_W * PlaneBuilder.TILE_H)
local baseU = nil               -- normalized coords, built lazily per tier
local baseV = nil
local tileU = nil
local tileV = nil
local edgeW = nil               -- per-vertex border taper (mesh tier)

local function buildNormCoords(w, h)
	local u = table.create(w * h)
	local v = table.create(w * h)
	for gy = 0, h - 1 do
		for gx = 0, w - 1 do
			local k = gy * w + gx + 1
			u[k] = gx / (w - 1)
			v[k] = gy / (h - 1)
		end
	end
	return u, v
end

-- Smoothstep taper from 0 at the UV border to 1 past EDGE_BAND.
local function buildEdgeWindow(u, v, count)
	local w = table.create(count)
	for k = 1, count do
		local d = math.min(u[k], 1 - u[k], v[k], 1 - v[k]) / EDGE_BAND
		if d > 1 then d = 1 end
		w[k] = d * d * (3 - 2 * d)
	end
	return w
end

-- Idle windows swap to SmoothPlastic with the Highlight off (glass at 1 still sheens); written only
-- on a change. A new mesh takes the current state.
local dimmed = false
local function applyDimToMesh()
	if not meshCanvas then return end
	local part = meshCanvas.part
	part.Material = dimmed and Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or Enum.Material.Glass
	if dimmed then part.Transparency = 1 end
	if meshCanvas.highlight then meshCanvas.highlight.Enabled = not dimmed end
end
local function setDimmed(on)
	if dimmed == on then return end
	dimmed = on
	applyDimToMesh()
	if tileCanvas then
		local mat = on and Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or Enum.Material.Glass
		for i = 1, tileCanvas.count do
			tileCanvas.tiles[i].Material = mat
			if on then tileCanvas.tiles[i].Transparency = 1 end
			local hl = tileCanvas.highlights[i]
			if hl then hl.Enabled = not on end
		end
	end
end

-- kindId: 1 Ripple, 2 Wave, 3 Noise, 4 Bulge, 5 Pinch. Called every live frame; atten pulls the
-- transparency toward 1 for distance fades. res: the mesh width asked for; the largest live request
-- wins, never lowered until teardown.
function Canvas.accumulate(kindId, amp, wavelength, phase, dirRad, noiseScale, lensRadius, epicU, epicV, seed, amplify, allowOver, trans, atten, res)
	if dormant then return end
	if cursor >= MAX_CONTRIB then
		if not overflowWarned then
			overflowWarned = true
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Distortion: more than " .. MAX_CONTRIB .. " simultaneous effects; extras dropped this frame")
		end
		return
	end
	cursor += 1
	cKind[cursor] = kindId
	cAmp[cursor] = amp
	cWavelength[cursor] = wavelength
	cPhase[cursor] = phase
	cDir[cursor] = dirRad
	cNoiseScale[cursor] = noiseScale
	cLensRadius[cursor] = lensRadius
	cEpicU[cursor] = epicU
	cEpicV[cursor] = epicV
	cSeed[cursor] = seed
	cAmplify[cursor] = amplify
	cAllowOver[cursor] = allowOver
	-- Above 1 asks for overdrive; atten pulls toward 1 from either side.
	local t = math.clamp(trans or BASE_TRANSPARENCY, 0, 10)
	local a = math.clamp(atten or 1, 0, 1)
	cTrans[cursor] = 1 - (1 - t) * a
	cRes[cursor] = res or PlaneBuilder.RES_W
end

-- Another engine's live plane, with its heartbeat.
local function foreignCanvasLive()
	local existing = VisualHost.root():FindFirstChild("__PartIclesDistortion")
	if not existing then return false end
	if existing:GetAttribute("_ownerSerial") == ownerSerial then return false end
	local hb = existing:GetAttribute("_hb")
	if typeof(hb) == "number" and (os.clock() - hb) < HEARTBEAT_STALE then
		return true
	end
	-- Its heartbeat is stale: its owner died. Take over.
	pcall(function() existing:Destroy() end)
	return false
end

local function goDormant()
	dormant = true
	if not dormantWarned then
		dormantWarned = true
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles] Distortion: another Part-Icles engine owns the screen canvas; this engine's distortions are disabled")
	end
end

-- Bumped by reset(), so a mesh build finishing after a teardown is thrown away.
local buildGen = 0

-- Grid height for a width, at 24:14.
local function deriveResH(resW)
	return math.max(4, math.floor(resW * PlaneBuilder.RES_H / PlaneBuilder.RES_W + 0.5))
end

-- Installs a finished mesh as the live plane, destroy and parent in one go so no frame lacks a plane.
local function installMeshBuild(built)
	local old = meshCanvas
	meshCanvas = nil
	if old then
		pcall(function() old.part:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() old.em:Destroy() end)
	end
	built.part:SetAttribute("_ownerSerial", ownerSerial)
	built.part:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	built.part.Transparency = BASE_TRANSPARENCY
	built.part.Parent = VisualHost.getCanvasParent()
	meshCanvas = built
	local count = built.resW * built.resH
	baseU, baseV = buildNormCoords(built.resW, built.resH)
	edgeW = buildEdgeWindow(baseU, baseV, count)
	height = table.create(count)
	applyDimToMesh()
end

local function ensureCanvas(targetResW)
	if meshCanvas or tileCanvas or building then return end
	if foreignCanvasLive() then
		goDormant()
		return
	end
	if meshTierAvailable == nil then
		meshTierAvailable = PlaneBuilder.probeMesh()
	end
	building = true
	local myGen = buildGen
	task.spawn(function()
		if meshTierAvailable then
			local built = PlaneBuilder.buildMesh(targetResW, deriveResH(targetResW))
			-- CreateMeshPartAsync yields; reset() may have run meanwhile.
			if buildGen ~= myGen then
				if built then
					pcall(function() built.part:Destroy() end)
					pcall(function() built.em:Destroy() end)
				end
				return
			end
			if built then
				installMeshBuild(built)
				building = false
				return
			end
			-- Failed mid-session: no mesh tier this session.
			meshTierAvailable = false
		end
		if buildGen ~= myGen then return end
		local tiles = PlaneBuilder.buildTiles()
		tiles.model:SetAttribute("_ownerSerial", ownerSerial)
		tiles.model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
		tiles.model.Parent = VisualHost.getCanvasParent()
		tileCanvas = tiles
		tileU, tileV = buildNormCoords(PlaneBuilder.TILE_W, PlaneBuilder.TILE_H)
		building = false
	end)
end

-- A higher resolution was asked for: built in the background, the old plane swapped out when done.
local function upgradeMesh(targetResW)
	building = true
	local myGen = buildGen
	task.spawn(function()
		local built = PlaneBuilder.buildMesh(targetResW, deriveResH(targetResW))
		if buildGen ~= myGen then
			if built then
				pcall(function() built.part:Destroy() end)
				pcall(function() built.em:Destroy() end)
			end
			return
		end
		if built then
			installMeshBuild(built)
		end
		building = false
	end)
end

-- The plane's Transparency: overdrive (Amplify, the most of them) only when every contribution
-- allows it, else the lowest of their graphs; never after a clamp.
local function resolveTransparency()
	if cursor == 0 then return 1 end
	if not overdriveLatched then
		local allOver = true
		local maxAmplify = 0
		for i = 1, cursor do
			if not cAllowOver[i] then
				allOver = false
				break
			end
			if cAmplify[i] > maxAmplify then maxAmplify = cAmplify[i] end
		end
		if allOver and maxAmplify > 0 then return math.clamp(maxAmplify, 4, 10) end
	end
	local minT = 10
	for i = 1, cursor do
		if cTrans[i] < minT then minT = cTrans[i] end
	end
	if overdriveLatched and minT > 1 then return BASE_TRANSPARENCY end
	return math.clamp(minT, 0, 10)
end

local function evalContributions(buf, u, v, count, aspect, ampScale)
	Field.zero(buf, count)
	for i = 1, cursor do
		-- A zero amplitude carries only transparency.
		if cAmp[i] ~= 0 then
			Field.accumulate(cKind[i], buf, u, v, count, aspect,
				cAmp[i] * ampScale, cWavelength[i], cPhase[i], cDir[i],
				cNoiseScale[i], cLensRadius[i], cEpicU[i], cEpicV[i], cSeed[i])
		end
	end
end

local function applyMesh(cam, wantT)
	local canvas = meshCanvas
	local halfH = MESH_DIST * math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) * 0.5) * MARGIN
	local vps = cam.ViewportSize
	local aspect = vps.X / math.max(1, vps.Y)
	local halfW = halfH * aspect
	local part = canvas.part
	part.CFrame = cam.CFrame * MESH_OFFSET
	part:SetAttribute("_hb", os.clock())
	-- Coverage via Size X/Y (mesh XY is unit extents); Z stays 1:1 studs.
	part.Size = Vector3.new(halfW * 2, halfH * 2, canvas.meshSizeZ)
	-- Should the engine clamp a value over 1, the safe value stays for the session.
	part.Transparency = wantT
	if wantT > 1 and math.abs(part.Transparency - wantT) > 0.01 then
		overdriveLatched = true
		part.Transparency = BASE_TRANSPARENCY
	end
	local count = canvas.resW * canvas.resH
	evalContributions(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, halfH * SLOPE_K)

	-- The sun's place on screen for the hole (plane V runs up, screen Y down).
	local sunOn = false
	local sunU, sunVbase = 0, 0
	local sunVp, sunInView = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(cam.CFrame.Position + Lighting:GetSunDirection() * 1000)
	if sunInView and sunVp.Z > 0 then
		sunOn = true
		sunU = sunVp.X / math.max(1, vps.X)
		sunVbase = 1 - sunVp.Y / math.max(1, vps.Y)
	end

	local em, ids, baseX, baseY = canvas.em, canvas.ids, canvas.baseX, canvas.baseY
	for i = 1, count do
		local z = height[i] * edgeW[i]
		if sunOn then
			local dx = (baseU[i] - sunU) * aspect
			local dy = baseV[i] - sunVbase
			local d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
			if d2 < SUN_HOLE_OUT2 then
				if d2 <= SUN_HOLE_IN2 then
					z = 0
				else
					local t = (d2 - SUN_HOLE_IN2) / (SUN_HOLE_OUT2 - SUN_HOLE_IN2)
					z = z * t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
				end
			end
		end
		if z > HEIGHT_CLAMP then
			z = HEIGHT_CLAMP
		elseif z < -HEIGHT_CLAMP then
			z = -HEIGHT_CLAMP
		end
		em:SetPosition(ids[i], Vector3.new(baseX[i], baseY[i], z))
	end
end

local function applyTiles(cam)
	local canvas = tileCanvas
	local count = canvas.count
	local vps = cam.ViewportSize
	local aspect = vps.X / math.max(1, vps.Y)
	evalContributions(tileHeight, tileU, tileV, count, aspect, 1)
	canvas.model:SetAttribute("_hb", os.clock())
	-- Transparency graphs on this tier scale tile opacity: minT 1 = faded out.
	local minT = 1
	for i = 1, cursor do
		if cTrans[i] < minT then minT = cTrans[i] end
	end
	local transFactor = 1 - math.clamp(minT, 0, 1)
	local camCF = cam.CFrame
	for i = 1, count do
		local dirCF = camCF * CFrame.Angles(canvas.pitchAng[i], canvas.yawAng[i], 0)
		canvas.writeCFs[i] = CFrame.lookAt(camCF.Position + dirCF.LookVector * TILE_DIST, camCF.Position)
		-- Idle tiles are invisible; strength pulls toward 0.5. This tier loses the sign.
		local mag = math.clamp(math.abs(tileHeight[i]) * 2, 0, 1)
		canvas.tiles[i].Transparency = 1 - mag * 0.5 * transFactor
	end
	workspace:BulkMoveTo(canvas.tiles, canvas.writeCFs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
end

-- A render step write lags a native camera move by a frame, so the plane also follows the
-- camera's CFrame signal (mesh tier only; tiles would be too heavy).
local camConn = nil
local camConnCam = nil
local function relockToCam()
	if meshCanvas and camConnCam and meshCanvas.part.Parent then
		meshCanvas.part.CFrame = camConnCam.CFrame * MESH_OFFSET
	end
end
local function ensureCamWeld(cam)
	if camConnCam == cam then return end
	if camConn then camConn:Disconnect() end
	camConnCam = cam
	camConn = cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(relockToCam)
end
local function dropCamWeld()
	if camConn then
		camConn:Disconnect()
		camConn = nil
	end
	camConnCam = nil
end

local function parkCanvas()
	dropCamWeld()
	if meshCanvas then
		pcall(function() meshCanvas.part.Parent = nil end)
	end
	if tileCanvas then
		pcall(function() tileCanvas.model.Parent = nil end)
	end
end

-- A plane destroyed from outside (another engine's sweep, Explorer) is dropped and rebuilt.
local function unparkCanvas()
	if meshCanvas and not meshCanvas.part.Parent then
		local ok = pcall(function() meshCanvas.part.Parent = VisualHost.getCanvasParent() end)
		if not ok then
			pcall(function() meshCanvas.em:Destroy() end)
			meshCanvas = nil
		end
	end
	if tileCanvas and not tileCanvas.model.Parent then
		local ok = pcall(function() tileCanvas.model.Parent = VisualHost.getCanvasParent() end)
		if not ok then
			tileCanvas = nil
		end
	end
end

function Canvas.applyFrame()
	local hadWork = cursor > 0
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		cursor = 0
		return
	end
	if not hadWork then
		-- Idle: still camera-locked (a still pane reads as a glass sheet), the field zeroed once.
		local live = (meshCanvas and meshCanvas.part.Parent) or (tileCanvas and tileCanvas.model.Parent)
		if live then
			if meshCanvas then ensureCamWeld(cam) end
			if idleSince == nil then
				idleSince = os.clock()
				if meshCanvas then applyMesh(cam, 1) else applyTiles(cam) end
				setDimmed(true)
			elseif os.clock() - idleSince >= IDLE_PARK_SECONDS then
				parkCanvas()
			else
				if meshCanvas then
					meshCanvas.part.CFrame = cam.CFrame * MESH_OFFSET
					meshCanvas.part:SetAttribute("_hb", os.clock())
				elseif tileCanvas then
					applyTiles(cam)
				end
			end
		end
		return
	end
	idleSince = nil
	-- When the other owner is gone, this engine takes the plane back.
	if dormant then
		if foreignCanvasLive() then
			cursor = 0
			return
		end
		dormant = false
	end
	-- A parked plane is invisible to the other engine's check, so it may have claimed one meanwhile.
	local parked = (meshCanvas and not meshCanvas.part.Parent)
		or (tileCanvas and not tileCanvas.model.Parent)
	if parked and foreignCanvasLive() then
		goDormant()
		cursor = 0
		return
	end
	unparkCanvas()
	-- The largest live request wins.
	local targetRes = PlaneBuilder.RES_W
	for i = 1, cursor do
		if cRes[i] > targetRes then targetRes = cRes[i] end
	end
	ensureCanvas(targetRes)
	-- Mid-upgrade the old plane keeps drawing.
	if dormant or (not meshCanvas and not tileCanvas) then
		cursor = 0
		return
	end
	if meshCanvas and not building and meshCanvas.resW < targetRes then
		upgradeMesh(targetRes)
	end
	local wantT = resolveTransparency()
	-- Every contribution faded to 1: the plane dims (glass at 1 still sheens).
	setDimmed(wantT >= 0.999 and wantT <= 1)
	if meshCanvas then
		ensureCamWeld(cam)
		applyMesh(cam, wantT)
	else
		applyTiles(cam)
	end
	cursor = 0
end

-- Teardown; the next Activate probes again (permissions may change).
function Canvas.reset()
	dropCamWeld()
	if meshCanvas then
		pcall(function() meshCanvas.part:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() meshCanvas.em:Destroy() end)
		meshCanvas = nil
	end
	if tileCanvas then
		pcall(function() tileCanvas.model:Destroy() end)
		tileCanvas = nil
	end
	cursor = 0
	building = false
	buildGen += 1
	meshTierAvailable = nil
	overdriveLatched = false
	idleSince = nil
	dimmed = false
	dormant = false
	dormantWarned = false
	overflowWarned = false
end

return Canvas

--[[
	Distortion/Field: pure height-field math for the screen-distortion canvas.
	No Roblox APIs (fengari-testable): plain arrays and numbers in, numbers out.

	Contract: every add* function ACCUMULATES amp-scaled height into `height[]` (the Canvas compositor
	relies on linearity: concurrent effects sum). baseU/baseV are normalized [0,1] across the plane;
	`aspect` corrects U distances so rings stay round on screen.

	Phase is the caller's effective-time integral (dtTs x Speed), so Timescale graphs, negative
	segments included, warp and reverse the animation.
]]

local Field = {}

-- Deterministic hash-based value noise (seedable, replay-stable; math.noise is Roblox-only and
-- zero on integer lattice points, so it is not used).
local function hash2(ix, iy, seed)
	local h = ix * 374761393 + iy * 668265263 + seed * 1442695040888963
	h = h % 2147483647
	h = (h * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
	return (h % 10000) / 10000
end

local function smooth(t)
	return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

-- Single-octave value noise at (x, y).
local function valueNoise(x, y, seed)
	local ix = math.floor(x)
	local iy = math.floor(y)
	local fx = smooth(x - ix)
	local fy = smooth(y - iy)
	local a = hash2(ix, iy, seed)
	local b = hash2(ix + 1, iy, seed)
	local c = hash2(ix, iy + 1, seed)
	local d = hash2(ix + 1, iy + 1, seed)
	local ab = a + (b - a) * fx
	local cd = c + (d - c) * fx
	return (ab + (cd - ab) * fy) * 2 - 1
end

Field.valueNoise = valueNoise

-- Expanding ring from the epicenter. The wavefront sits at d == phase; a gaussian window of width
-- about wavelength keeps a tight band around it.
function Field.addRipple(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, epicU, epicV)
	if amp == 0 then return end
	local wl = math.max(wavelength, 0.02)
	local invW = 1 / wl
	local twoPi = 2 * math.pi
	for i = 1, count do
		local dx = (baseU[i] - epicU) * aspect
		local dy = baseV[i] - epicV
		local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
		local front = (d - phase) * invW
		height[i] += amp * math.cos(twoPi * front) * math.exp(-front * front * 4)
	end
end

-- Travelling sine wave; dirRad = travel direction in plane space.
function Field.addWave(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, dirRad)
	if amp == 0 then return end
	local wl = math.max(wavelength, 0.02)
	local kx = math.cos(dirRad) / wl
	local ky = math.sin(dirRad) / wl
	local twoPi = 2 * math.pi
	for i = 1, count do
		local s = baseU[i] * aspect * kx + baseV[i] * ky
		height[i] += amp * math.sin(twoPi * (s - phase / wl))
	end
end

-- 2-octave scrolling value noise; scroll direction dirRad, seed decorrelates concurrent effects.
function Field.addNoise(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, scale, phase, dirRad, seed)
	if amp == 0 then return end
	local sx = math.cos(dirRad) * phase
	local sy = math.sin(dirRad) * phase
	for i = 1, count do
		local u = (baseU[i] * aspect - sx) * scale
		local v = (baseV[i] - sy) * scale
		height[i] += amp * (valueNoise(u, v, seed) + 0.5 * valueNoise(u * 2.13, v * 2.13, seed + 71))
	end
end

-- Static lens dome: the sign of amp picks bulge (+) or pinch (-). Phase-independent.
function Field.addLens(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, radius, epicU, epicV)
	if amp == 0 then return end
	local r = math.max(radius, 0.02)
	local invR2 = 1 / (r * r)
	for i = 1, count do
		local dx = (baseU[i] - epicU) * aspect
		local dy = baseV[i] - epicV
		local q = 1 - (dx * dx + dy * dy) * invR2
		if q > 0 then
			height[i] += amp * q * q
		end
	end
end

-- Zeroes the height buffer (table.clear nils entries; the hot loop needs 0s).
function Field.zero(height, count)
	for i = 1, count do
		height[i] = 0
	end
end

-- Dispatches one contribution by kind id (1 Ripple, 2 Wave, 3 Noise, 4 Bulge, 5 Pinch). Bulge and
-- Pinch share addLens with signed amp.
function Field.accumulate(kindId, height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, dirRad, noiseScale, lensRadius, epicU, epicV, seed)
	if kindId == 1 then
		Field.addRipple(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, epicU, epicV)
	elseif kindId == 2 then
		Field.addWave(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, dirRad)
	elseif kindId == 3 then
		Field.addNoise(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, noiseScale, phase, dirRad, seed)
	elseif kindId == 4 then
		Field.addLens(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, lensRadius, epicU, epicV)
	elseif kindId == 5 then
		Field.addLens(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, -amp, lensRadius, epicU, epicV)
	end
end

--[[
	Distortion/PlaneBuilder: constructs the shared canvas backends.

	Mesh tier: EditableMesh grid plane, unit XY extents ([-0.5..0.5]), with a tiny baked Z relief so
	MeshSize has a nonzero Z (a flat mesh renders nothing). Canvas drives screen coverage via
	MeshPart.Size X/Y per frame and TRUE-stud height via vertex Z (Size.Z = MeshSize.Z keeps Z 1:1), so
	the per-frame write is Z-only. Single-sided winding toward local +Z (the camera).

	Tile tier: RES_TW x RES_TH squashed-Ball glass lenses on a shallow sphere section, each facing the
	camera; per-tile Transparency is the strength knob. Gaps between tiles stay (overlapping glass culls itself).

	Both tiers use Glass + a Highlight child (FillTransparency 1, OutlineTransparency 0.98).
]]

local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

local PlaneBuilder = {}

PlaneBuilder.RES_W = 24
PlaneBuilder.RES_H = 14
PlaneBuilder.TILE_W = 8
PlaneBuilder.TILE_H = 5

local function addRecipeHighlight(part)
	local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
	hl.FillTransparency = 1
	hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.98
	hl.Parent = part
	return hl
end

local function configurePart(part)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	-- Locked keeps a click in the Studio viewport from picking the canvas.
	part.Locked = true
	part.Archivable = false
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
	part.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

-- Capability probe: EditableMesh creation can be permission-gated or return nil on memory budget.
function PlaneBuilder.probeMesh()
	local ok, em = pcall(function()
		return AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()
	end)
	if ok and em then
		pcall(function() em:Destroy() end)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Builds the mesh-tier canvas at the grid resolution (default RES_W x RES_H). YIELDS
-- (CreateMeshPartAsync): the caller wraps it in task.spawn and treats the canvas as building until
-- the callback fires. Returns nil on failure.
function PlaneBuilder.buildMesh(resW, resH)
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local em = AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()
		if not em then return nil end
		local W = resW or PlaneBuilder.RES_W
		local H = resH or PlaneBuilder.RES_H
		local ids = table.create(W * H)
		local baseX = table.create(W * H)
		local baseY = table.create(W * H)
		for gy = 0, H - 1 do
			for gx = 0, W - 1 do
				local x = gx / (W - 1) - 0.5
				local y = gy / (H - 1) - 0.5
				-- Baked corner relief: nonzero Z bounds without disturbing the flat centre.
				local z = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) and 0.004 or -0.004
				local k = gy * W + gx + 1
				ids[k] = em:AddVertex(Vector3.new(x, y, z))
				baseX[k] = x
				baseY[k] = y
			end
		end
		-- Auto vertex normals are REQUIRED: the tilted normals of the displaced grid ARE the glass
		-- refraction; flat normals kill the warp. Sun smear is handled by Canvas's sun-hole mask.
		for gy = 0, H - 2 do
			for gx = 0, W - 2 do
				local a = ids[gy * W + gx + 1]
				local b = ids[gy * W + gx + 2]
				local c = ids[(gy + 1) * W + gx + 1]
				local d = ids[(gy + 1) * W + gx + 2]
				-- Winding faces local +Z.
				em:AddTriangle(a, b, d)
				em:AddTriangle(a, d, c)
			end
		end
		local mp = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(em))
		mp.Name = "__PartIclesDistortion"
		configurePart(mp)
		mp.Size = mp.MeshSize
		local hl = addRecipeHighlight(mp)
		return { part = mp, em = em, ids = ids, baseX = baseX, baseY = baseY,
			meshSizeZ = mp.MeshSize.Z, highlight = hl, resW = W, resH = H }
	end)
	if ok then return result end
	return nil
end

-- Builds the tile-tier canvas: a model of lens parts plus their view-sphere angular offsets
-- (Canvas re-aims each tile from the live camera every frame).
function PlaneBuilder.buildTiles()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "__PartIclesDistortion"
	local tiles = {}
	local highlights = {}
	local yawAng = {}
	local pitchAng = {}
	local TW, TH = PlaneBuilder.TILE_W, PlaneBuilder.TILE_H
	local spacing = math.rad(10)
	local n = 0
	for gy = 1, TH do
		for gx = 1, TW do
			local lens = Instance.new("Part")
			lens.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			lens.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.26)
			configurePart(lens)
			lens.Transparency = 1
			lens.Name = "Lens" .. gx .. "_" .. gy
			lens.Parent = model
			n += 1
			tiles[n] = lens
			highlights[n] = addRecipeHighlight(lens)
			yawAng[n] = -(gx - (TW + 1) / 2) * spacing
			pitchAng[n] = (gy - (TH + 1) / 2) * spacing
		end
	end
	return { model = model, tiles = tiles, highlights = highlights, yawAng = yawAng,
		pitchAng = pitchAng, count = n, writeCFs = table.create(n) }
end

return PlaneBuilder

--[[
	DragModel: which drag an item's stored Drag number means, and the rate the motion code uses.
	Motion scales a particle's speed by e ^ (-rate * t). Two models give the rate:
	  Roblox (config attribute DragModel = "Roblox")  rate = ln(2) * Drag. Speed halves every 1 / Drag
	          seconds, as a native ParticleEmitter's does. Every item Transform makes.
	  first  (no DragModel attribute)                 rate = Drag. An older item keeps its motion until
	          Fix converts its number and marks it (Modules/Migrate/Drag).
	Drag slows the Speed graph only; Acceleration is not dragged (a native emitter drags that too, Part/NativeMotion).
	  DragModel.rate(config, key) -> number    key: "Drag", or "ImgDrag" for image particles
	  DragModel.isRoblox(config) -> boolean
	  DragModel.mark(config)                   puts a config on the Roblox model
	  DragModel.toRoblox(drag) -> number       the Roblox Drag that moves as this first-model Drag did
	The rate is proportional to the stored Drag in both models; Retime relies on that (typeDef.retime
	multiplyNumbers, Modules/QOL). Resize leaves Drag alone. No requires. Lightning and Rope keep their
	own Drag (damping), not read here.
	Consumers: GetData (rate), Transform (mark), Modules/Migrate/Drag (isRoblox, toRoblox, mark).
]]

local DragModel = {}

DragModel.ATTRIBUTE = "DragModel"
DragModel.ROBLOX = "Roblox"

local LN2 = math.log(2)
-- A converted Drag is kept to this many decimals: 1 becomes 1.4427, not 1.4426950408889634.
local CONVERTED_DECIMALS = 4

function DragModel.isRoblox(config)
	return config:GetAttribute(DragModel.ATTRIBUTE) == DragModel.ROBLOX
end

function DragModel.rate(config, key)
	local drag = config:GetAttribute(key)
	if type(drag) ~= "number" then
		return 0
	end
	if DragModel.isRoblox(config) then
		return drag * LN2
	end
	return drag
end

function DragModel.mark(config)
	config:SetAttribute(DragModel.ATTRIBUTE, DragModel.ROBLOX)
end

function DragModel.toRoblox(drag)
	local scale = 10 ^ CONVERTED_DECIMALS
	return math.floor(drag / LN2 * scale + 0.5) / scale
end

return DragModel

--[[
	Duration  -  true real-time wallclock for an emit dispatch.
	Honors EmitDelay, EmitDuration ranges, AnimateLoop, PartLife, and Timescale graph distortion
	(numerical integration; piecewise-linear graphs have no closed form).
	Returns nil for "effectively infinite" (AnimateLoop unbounded, Timescale=0, or Timescale
	clamps to a sign that never reaches the death boundary).
]]

local Graph = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local Duration = {}

local INTEGRATION_STEPS = 200

local function resolveDuration(raw)
	if raw == nil then return 0 end
	if typeof(raw) == "number" then return raw end
	local vals = {}
	for v in tostring(raw):gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
		if n then table.insert(vals, n) end
	end
	if #vals == 0 then return 0 end
	if #vals == 1 then return vals[1] end
	return math.max(vals[1], vals[2])
end

-- Wallclock time from spawn to death for one particle of the given lifetime + Timescale
-- curve. Integrates ts(real_i) over [0,1]; if effective time hasn't crossed the boundary,
-- the terminal ts(1) is held constant until it does.
function Duration.computeTrueLifetime(lifetime, timescaleGraph, seed)
	if not lifetime or lifetime <= 0 then return 0 end
	if not timescaleGraph then return lifetime end

	if Graph.IsStatic(timescaleGraph) then
		local v = Graph.GetStaticValue(timescaleGraph, 1)
		if v == 1 then return lifetime end
		if v == 0 then return nil end
		if v > 0 then return lifetime / v end
		return lifetime / (-v)
	end

	local seed_ = seed or {}
	local ts0 = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(0, timescaleGraph, seed_)
	local reverse = ts0 < 0
	local eff = reverse and lifetime or 0
	local realT = 0
	local dRealT = lifetime / INTEGRATION_STEPS

	for i = 1, INTEGRATION_STEPS do
		local real_i = i / INTEGRATION_STEPS
		local ts = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, timescaleGraph, seed_)
		local prevEff = eff
		eff = eff + ts * dRealT
		if not reverse and eff >= lifetime then
			local frac = (lifetime - prevEff) / (eff - prevEff)
			return realT + frac * dRealT
		end
		if reverse and eff <= 0 then
			local frac = prevEff / (prevEff - eff)
			return realT + frac * dRealT
		end
		realT = realT + dRealT
	end

		-- Phase 2: real_i clamps at 1, ts stays at ts(1) (as Update.luau).
	local tsTerminal = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(1, timescaleGraph, seed_)
	if reverse then
		if tsTerminal >= 0 then return nil end
		return realT + eff / (-tsTerminal)
	end
	if tsTerminal <= 0 then return nil end
	return realT + (lifetime - eff) / tsTerminal
end

-- Returns a lifecycle descriptor for a single item, or nil when the item is not fire-eligible
-- (no count, no duration, not a recognized emitter type). `overrides` (EmitAt options Count /
-- Delay / Duration) replace a transformed item's attributes. Descriptor fields:
--   emitDelay   = scheduling delay before this item starts firing
--   emitDur     = burst window or continuous-Enable duration in seconds
--   lifecycle   = trailing real-time after emit ends until the last spawned particle dies
--   infinite    = true when this item is unbounded (AnimateLoop without EmitDuration,
--                 or Timescale that never reaches the death boundary)
function Duration.computeItemLifecycle(item, overrides)
	if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		local config = item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties")
		local emitDelay = item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0
		local emitDur = resolveDuration(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
		local rawCount = item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
		local count = rawCount == nil and 1 or rawCount
		if overrides then
			if overrides.Delay ~= nil then emitDelay = overrides.Delay end
			if overrides.Duration ~= nil then emitDur = resolveDuration(overrides.Duration) end
			if overrides.Count ~= nil then count = overrides.Count end
		end
		local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") or "Emit"
		local animateLoop = item:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") == true

		if emissionMode == "Animate" and animateLoop and emitDur <= 0 then
			return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = 0, lifecycle = 0, infinite = true }
		end
		local fires = (count > 0) or (emitDur > 0) or (emissionMode == "Animate")
		if not fires then return nil end

		local lifetime = config and config:GetAttribute("Lifetime")
		local lifetimeMax = 0
		if typeof(lifetime) == "NumberRange" then lifetimeMax = lifetime.Max
		elseif type(lifetime) == "number" then lifetimeMax = lifetime end

		local timescale = config and config:GetAttribute("Timescale")
		local trueLife = Duration.computeTrueLifetime(lifetimeMax, timescale, nil)
		if trueLife == nil then
			return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = emitDur, lifecycle = 0, infinite = true }
		end

		local partLife = (config and config:GetAttribute("PartLife")) or 0
				-- Animate mode runs at least one full lifecycle even with EmitDuration=0.
		if emissionMode == "Animate" and trueLife > emitDur then emitDur = trueLife end

		return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = emitDur, lifecycle = trueLife + partLife, infinite = false }
	end

	if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		local count = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")) or 1
		local emitDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		local emitDur = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		if count <= 0 and emitDur <= 0 then return nil end
		local life = item.Lifetime
		local lifeMax = (typeof(life) == "NumberRange" and life.Max) or 0
		return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = emitDur, lifecycle = lifeMax, infinite = false }
	end

	if item:IsA("Trail") then
		local tDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		local tDur = resolveDuration(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
		if tDur <= 0 then return nil end
		return { emitDelay = tDelay, emitDur = tDur, lifecycle = item.Lifetime or 0, infinite = false }
	end

	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		local bDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		local bDur = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		if bDur <= 0 then return nil end
		return { emitDelay = bDelay, emitDur = bDur, lifecycle = 0, infinite = false }
	end

	return nil
end

-- Recursive walk. Returns the max finish-time across this item and its emit-eligible
-- descendants, or nil if any branch is infinite. Follows EmitDispatch.descendantMaxEmitTime:
-- a transformed no-op ends its subtree, RenderTemplate children recurse only into transformed
-- descendants. `overrides` reach the items the call fires directly, never nested emitters.
function Duration.computeMaxDuration(item, accumDelay, overrides)
	if not item then return 0 end
	accumDelay = accumDelay or 0

	local info = Duration.computeItemLifecycle(item, overrides)
	local myFinish = 0
	local childAccum = accumDelay
	local skipChildren = false

	if info then
		if info.infinite then return nil end
		myFinish = accumDelay + info.emitDelay + info.emitDur + info.lifecycle
		childAccum = accumDelay + info.emitDelay
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		end
	else
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			skipChildren = true
		end
	end

	if not skipChildren then
		for _, child in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Name == "RenderTemplate" then
				for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
					if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
						local sub = Duration.computeMaxDuration(desc, childAccum)
						if sub == nil then return nil end
						if sub > myFinish then myFinish = sub end
					end
				end
			else
				local sub = Duration.computeMaxDuration(child, childAccum, overrides)
				if sub == nil then return nil end
				if sub > myFinish then myFinish = sub end
			end
		end
	end

	return myFinish
end

return Duration

local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local MeshFlipMod = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)

local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.MeshFrames)
local ContainerColors = require(script.Parent.Container.Colors)
local ContainerFade = require(script.Parent.Container.Fade)
local RollLock = require(script.Parent.RollLock)
local ContainerLines = require(script.Parent.Container.Lines)
